1000: Deitdabbekuta didchura benukeba. keden itreshimu behay rucha, innun atvavn. vehacha amar david, (Tehillim 94:22) velohay letzur machsi. raza derucha da deikre el veraza deinnun atvavn dirshimin beh, deikrun Yahu, illen telat sitrin dinhorin dekaamaran.

Innun telat bate dinin, demitpallege bedinin acharanin, bemille dealma, beutera, bemiskenu, bemarin, bishlimu, deinnun arba hechalin deinnun metakkenan lechol innun acharanin, terin hechalin leillen tere sitre nehorin acharanin, vechad hechala lechol innun mare deayynin, deavde chushevana michol ovadin dealma. vechad hechala, lesofrin acharanin, di techot illen kadmae penimae. illen arba hechalin, kelilan behechala da, deikre al shema dehay rucha zechuta, kidkamran.

Bechol pitcha ufitcha deillen hechalin, it memana chad, befitcha kadmaa it memana chada, dishmeh ikre gazriel. (lefitcha kadmaa dishmeh decholla 235 dameyneh natil) hay memana achara, hahu memana ihu legallaa dinin, deitdanu veitgezaru lehahu memana kadmaa, dishmeh sansaniyyah deminneh natil hay memana achara, dekayyeyma al hechala desitra achara, vekayyeyma al askara deravye, kidkamran.

Vehay memana gazriel, natil milla deve dina penimaa. decholla, itgezar tamman, ucheden odia milla lehay memana dilvar, vechol innun karoze machreze veamre bechol rekiin, kach vechach itgezar mibbe malka, ad denatle hahi milla behechala diltatta, umittamman nafke umachreze milla, ad deishtema bechullehu rekiin tatain, venachte veode milla, lechullehu diltatta.

Venatle milla kullehu tattain, midarga ledarga, afillu tzippore shemaya, veofe deara, kullehu natle milla, veode lah bealma. ad denatle milla kol innun gardine nimusin, veachzeyayn bechelma livne nasha, veatya hahi milla lizman kariv.

Ulezimnin dehahi milla deitztericha lemalche ara, deinnun memanan leatzena, uledabbera amin. deodin hahi milla ad rekia deshimsha diltatta, vekayyeyma tamman. ad deinnun memanan shimsha, deitmanun al shimsha, natle hahi milla, veode lah leinnun memanan illain di besitra achara, veinnun modiin hahi milla lemalche ara, deinnun besitra dilhon.

Vechad havo neviim behu beyisrael, havo natlin nevua dilhon, mitteren ammudin illain deorayyta samich alayyhu. levatar deistalaku neviim mealma, veatu mare demare, umare dechelma, natle milla meatreh kidkaamran. vechad malche havo benayyhu deyisrael, uneviim istalaku, umare dechelma umare la ishtechachu, odin milla leinnun malchin, mehay pitcha kidkaamran.

Vei tema hech natil milla mehay atar. ta chaze, kol darga vedarga, vechol pitcha ufitcha, kullehu it lon levar, memanan yedian, deitmanun (besitra dilhon) bechol innun rekiin, ad denachte letatta birkiin tattain veodin milla leinnun deitzterich begin deha meillen hechalin deinnun sitra dikdushsha veraza dimhemnuta, itperashu dargin letatta, kullehu beraza dimhemnuta, venachtu dargin al dargin, ad defarchin mehay alma, veitmenun beh.

Minnehon, lenatra bene nasha missitra achara, uminnezike alma, uveinnun arche deka azle. uminnehon, lesayyeya livne nasha, kad atan leitdacha. uminnehon, lemebad atin venissin bealma. uminnehon dekayyme leashgacha beovadin divne nasha, lemishad sahaduta. vechen (begavvna da) mitparshin kama dargin lesitrayyhu, vechullehu beraza dimhemnuta illaa, bikdushsha illaa.

Kegavvna da besitra achara, sitra mesaava, mitparshin dargin meinnun hechalin letatta, kullehu dargin leavasha, uleastaa alma: minnehon, kayyme leastaa beni nasha, meorach tav leorach bisha. uminnehon kayyme lesaava beni
1001: Nasha, leinnun deatu leistaava, kema detanenan, ata bar nash leistaava, mesaavin leh behay alma, umesaavin leh behahu alma, veinnun ikru tzoa rotachat. kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 30:22) tze tomar lo. veinnun dargin dekayyman lesaava yatir, uvegin kach, illen tadir lokovel illen, vecholla ihu bedargin yedian kadka chaze.

Pitcha tinyayna. behay pitcha it memana, dahariel shemeh. veihu listar yemina, vehay ihu memana, leaala kol zechutin dezachu behu bene nasha, begin deyitdan bar nash letav alayyhu kad ittedan letav, veinnun zachyayn kayyman sagian al chove bene nasha, keden hay memana, pakid al agra vechulaka deinnun zachyayn veagran letav.

Veappik hahu dina, umane leh lehahu memana, deikre pedayel, di behechala telitaa. ucheden amar leh, (Iyov 33:24) pedaehu meredet shachat. begin dechad bar nash kaim beve mareh, veitpas bitfisu demalka, keden itdan bar nash. vechol zechu vechol chova deavad behay alma, kolla al behay hechala leitdena.

Vechad itdan letav, behay pitcha nafak dineh letav, limina dehay memana dahariel, dekayyeyma beh, veodin dinih letav, ad deishteziv. venachta hahu dina, bechol innun memanan, dargin deishtemodau letav letata, kullehu dargin al dargin, vecholla, ben letav ben levish, mibbe malka itdan hahu bar nash.

Pitcha telitaa. behay pitcha it memana chad, gadiel shemeh. veihu listar semala, vehay ihu memana, leaala (sefer acher laatakelaa) kol chovin vechol bishin, debar nash aste avatrayyhu behay alma. venachit lon go matkela leatkela, beinnun zachyayn dealu bida dehahu memana achara dekaamaran.

Vehahu matkela kayyeyma go pitcha reviaa, vetamman itkalu zachyayn vechovin kachada. man denatzach minnayyhu, hachi it leh memanan behahu sitra. i natzchan zachyayn, kama memanan it bistar dimina, venatle hahu dina, umaavirin bishin umarin mehahu bar nash, ad deishteziv. i natzchan chovin, kama memanan it leh behahu sitra dismala, ad denatle milla hahu sitra achara, vechol innun gardini nimmusin, ad deitra mazzaleh. ucheden nachta hahu sitra achara, venatil nishmeta. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay bealma den uvealma deate.

Pitcha reviaa. behay pitcha, kayyeyma chad memana, 79 (sefer acher 113) shemeh. vehay ihu matkela, denatla (sefer acher datekayl) zachyayn vechovin, uveh ittekalu kullehu kachada. veda ikre (255 amud alef) mozne tzedek. kedichtiv (Vayikra 19:36) mozni tzedek. behay ittekalu kullehu leittedna.

Techot hay memana, it teren memanan, chad limina vechad lismala. chad limina, hariel shemeh. chad lismala, gedudiel shemeh. vechad ittekalu zachyayn vechovin, da achra listar yemina, veda achra listar semala. vechullehu itkelilu behay rucha deikre zechut el.

Vechad itkelilan kullehu beh, appik (sefer acher chad) chevata, kaddisha, vehay chevata melahata, veikre shemeh, tumiel. hay chevata, ihi chevata dekayyeyma leashgacha bealma, beinnun eni Adonai, deazlan veshatan bealma. veinnun ene Adonai, kullehu natlu ashgachuta, meinnun ovadin tavin deitavedu bitmiru, uleashgacha beinnun ovadin deinnun bishlimu delibba, veaf al gav dela itavidu kadka yeot.

Hay chevata ihi kayyeyma beashgachuta ditzlotin. begin deinnun sheeltin deshaale beni nasha bitzlotehon, kullehu kayyme bida dehay chevata, veanach lehu behay hechala, vekayymin innun sheeltin behay hechala ad arbein yomin, leashgacha behu.

Deha (besof arbein yomin) bechol arbein vearbein, nafka hay chevata, venatil lechol innun sheeltin, veanach lon kamayyhu deinnun shivin uteren nehorin, vedayynin lon. ucheden hay rucha deikre zechut el,
1002: Meayyen behu, i zache i la zache. i zache, nafka hay tzelota, umitgalgela hay sheelta, venafkan immah teresar memanan, vechol chad vechad tavin meim hahu rucha, kiuma behay sheelta, veitkayyeyma behu.

Techot hay chevata, arbaa serafin melahatan, serafel, barkiel, kerishiel kedumeyyah. veillen arba techot hay chevata kayymin learba sitre alma, illen 4 kayyme led sitre alma, veinnun memanan leashgacha bechol innun denatre yoma deshabbeta, umeannege shabbeta kedka yeot.

Meillen arba kad natle, nafke shevivin deeshsha, umeillen shevivin itavidu shivin uteren galgallin, melahatan beeshsha. mehacha itavid nehar dinur. elef alfin yeshammeshuneh lehahu nahara, kol innun dimannege shabbeta, illen arba memanan mashgechan bechol innun dimannege shabbeta, vehay chevata kayyeyma alayyhu, venatle beginah techotah.

Bechol yoma veyoma, nagid hahu nehar dinur, veokid lechamma ruchin, ulechama shallitin. vechad ayiyil shabbeta, karoza nafka, veshachich hahu nehar dinur, vezapin vezikin ushevivin ishtechachu. vehay chevata azla vesalleka al arbaa illen serafim dekaamaran. veal go emtzaita dehechala da, behahu atar deikre oneg.

Begin divhay atar, kad ayel shabbeta, mitsadderan tamman kol patore divne alma, deikru bene hechala demalka, veelef alfin, veribbo ribbevavn memanan, kayyme al innun patore. vehay chevata illaa al illen arbaa serafim, veal behahu atar, vechama kol innun patore, (vechol inun dekayyeyma alayyhu) veashgach bechol patora ufatora, vehech meannege leh lechol patora ufatora, vekayyeyma uvarich leh lehahu patora. vechol innun elef alfin, veribbo ribbevan, kullehu patche veamre amen.

Uma beracha hi devarich al hay patora demitsadar veitannega kedka yeot. (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai vegomer ki pi Adonai dibber. vechullehu amre, (Yeshayahu 58:19) az tikra vaAdonai yaane vegomer. rucha illaa deikre zechut el, kad hahu patora itannag bechullehu seudate, bisudata batraa telitaa mesayyem veamar, al kol innun kadmae, veamar (Yeshayahu 58:8) az yibbaka kashachar orecha vegomer, kevod Adonai yaaspecha. kol innun shivin nehorin acharanin bechol sitrin, patche veamre, (Tehillim 128:4) hinne ki chen yevorach gaver yere Adonai.

Vechad patora devar nash la kayyeyma behahu atar besiddura deinnuga kedka yeot, keden hay chevata, veinnun arba ditchotah, vechol innun elef alfin veribbo ribbevan, kullehu dachyayn leh levar, lehahu sitra achara, uchemma gardini nimusin, kullehu natle leh veayyle leh lehahu atar, deihu behippucha min da, veikre nega. vechad ayiyil lah tamman, (sefer acher pitche) veamre (Tehillim 109:17) vayeehav kelala vattevoehu velo chafetz bivracha vattirchak mimmennu. (Tehillim 109:17) yenakkesh noshe lechol asher lo vegomer, al yehi lo moshech chased vegomer. rachamana lishezvan.

Begin deinnuga deshabbeta, umehemnuta dekudesha berich hu (sefer acher hay ihu illen patore daaynevagea deshabbeta uzemanin vechaggin kullehu chedvavta dekudesha berich hu) ihu. uvegin da, kol innun dimange innuga deshabbeta vezimne umoade, illen arba dekayyme techot hay chevata, kayyeyma lokovel hahu nehar dinur, vela shavke leittokda beh, lechol innun demitannege innugayyhu kedka yeot.
Techot illen arba, it memanan acharanin, dekayyme levar, deishtemodan missitra dehechala da (vechol charozin levar) umachreze lecholla innun dinin, vechol innun gizrin deitgezaru behay hechala.

Kolla ittedan hacha, bar telat millin, dela ityeyhiv reshu hacha behechala da deikre zechuta. villen (Bereshit 43 amud bet, 181 amud alef, Vayikra 25 amud bet) innun: bene, chayye, umezone. deha illen telata, la kayyme hacha, begin deha bemazzala talyan. deha hahu nahar denagid venafik, tamman talyayn chayyin dilella, vetamman talyayn mezone, vetamman talyayn bene, deha illen telata mittamman nafke, venagde veitmashshechan letatta. uvegin kach, kolla kayyeyma behechala da, bar hane telata.
Bar nash kad ihu beve mareh, hacha ittedan, vechol shear dinin dealma. vi tema, bar nash beve
1003: Mareh, i ittedan lachayyim yahavin leh. lav dechayyin talyayn hacha, ella kad ittedan hacha lechayyim, keden nagdin chayyim milleella, veyahave leh. (vei lo lo yahavin) zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay deyade archoy deorayyta, vezakkan bah lechayye alma, alayyhu ketiv (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kulam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz vegomer.

Hechal ahava 72 hechala chamishaa, hechala da kayyeyma leanhara leillen tattae. vehay ihu hechala dekayyeyma leanhara beraza dimhemnuta. pitcha chada kayyeyma behay hechala, vechad memana aleh, vehahu memana ikre sanigorya. hay memana kayyeyma al pitcha da, begin lemelaf (sefer acher sannegorya alayyhu deyisrael uvegin da ikre shemeh kach deha ihu memana al kol inun tavin deyisrael lemeal) sannegora dilhon, kammeh demarehon. vela yishlot alayyhu sitra achara.

Behechala da, kayyeyma chad rucha, dechalil bearba, deha rucha da kalil bearba gevavnin, chivvavr veucham yarok vesumak. vehay ihu rucha dekayyeyma kalil becholla, veikre suriyya, rav al kol innun chayyaylin tattain. vechullehu kayymin techoteh, umemanan techot yedeh.

Hay rucha, desagir ufatach. kol maftechan illain kullehu itmasran bideh. (telat zimnin beyoma) kol chayyaylin tattain, kullehu itkelilan vekayyman techoteh, uminneh itzanu. hay kayyeyma bechol razin demareh, kol genizin illain kullehu itmasran bideh.

Hay rucha ikre ahava. uvegin da, ikre hechol da, hechol ahava. begin dehacha itgenizu kol raza derazin, leman deitzterich leitdabbeka beh. vehacha hu raza dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 7:13) sham etten et dodi lach.

Rucha da, ihu natir kol netiru dilella, veda ikre (tehillim 121) shomer yisrael. (Devarim 7:9) shomer habberit. begin dehacha ihu netiru dechol ginzin illain, veal da genizin demareh genizin beh. mehay nafke shevilin vearchin leinnun diltatta, begin leatara behu rucha dirchimuta.

Illen 4 gevavnin deveh, ittechlilan da beda. vechad baan leachlela, batash da beda, venafak mikkullehu chad chevata kadisha, deikre zohar. vehay chevata al da ketiv, (Yechezkel 10:22) hi hachayya asher raiti al nehar kevar.

Mehechala da, nafkin kol ruchin kadishin dekayymin bekiyyuma denshikin (illain). deha meinnun neshikin, nafka avera derucha, lekiyyuma denafsha lechol innun nishmatin illain, deityeyhivu bivne nasha. veraza hahu dichtiv, (Devarim 8:3) ki al kol motza pi Adonai yichye haadam. begin divhay hechala kayymin kol nishmatin, vechol ruchin, dizminin lenachta bivni nasha, miyyoma deitbere alma. veal da, hechala da nakta, kol innun nishmatin denafkin mehahu nahar denagid venafik. uvegin da, hechala da la kayyeyma lealma berekanayyay.

Umiyyoma deitcharav be makdesha, la alu hacha nishmatin acharanin. vechad yistayymun illen, hechala kayyeyma berekanayya, veyitpekad milleella, ucheden yete malka meshicha. veatar hechala da leella, veyitar hechala letata.

Uveraza dehechala da ketiv, (Shir HaShirim 4:Adonai) sheni shadayich kishni ofarim vegomer. begin divhechala da hahu rucha dekaamaran, vehahu chevata, afik teren nehorin kelilan da beda, mitkashsheran da beda, veikrun el shadday. illen ikrun shadday, veel diltatta, mitchabberan da beda, veail da beda, veikre el shaday. begin denafak michlala deillen shadayim.

Vehay el deihu missitra dimina, natil meatar da, kol innun rachamin, dekayyme leatzana hahu hechala diltata, deikre zechuta, al shema dehay rucha deveh dekaamaran. hay shadday, yanik lechol innun tattain, ulechol innun hechalin, ulechol innun dilvar, dekayyme missitra da, deikrun yitdot hammishkan, kema deokimna. veal da ikre shadday, begin dimsappeka mezona lechullehu tattae, kema deihu mekabbela, missitra dimina.
Mehacha, nafku innun nehorin, deikrun (Bereshit 3:24) lahat hacherev hammithappechet. begin demithappecha lechamma gevavnin, veha okimna, deillen mitare dina bishlichuta dilella, veinnun bealma
1004: Missetar semala, kad itperash (sefer acher itpashat) rucha da, uvatash leafaka nehorin lechol sitrin, keinnun shadayim deraman chalava lechol setar, hachi name mehay rucha, nafke lechol setar, veafiku chad chevata achara, di memana al illen, deikre lahat hacherev hammithappechet. veda ikre. (chaser) (sefer acher sheva veda ihu dimmana)

Vehahu vehay dimmana al alma. bezimna di memana kafna al alma veitdan beh, keden hay chevata itpakda al alma, veafik rucha dimzona, lechol innun bene mehemnuta, dela yemutun bechafna, vesaid libbayyhu. begin deha missitra achara, kad shalta kafna bealma, nafke mehay sitra teren ruchin misavin, veikrun shod vechafan. veda ihu raza, (Iyov Adonai:22) leshod ulechafan tischak. begin deillen kayymin bealma, veavdin lon livne nasha kitruga. chad, hahu deka meshadder lehu kafna, umayyti. vechad, deka achle bene nasha vela savin, begin deha rucha bisha shalta bealma.
Chevata da, afik chad nitzotza, deka nafik minnetzitzu ditren nitzotzin deamaran, deinnun mithappechan lechamma gevavnin. vehay nitzotza ikre serafim, vehay achid behon, velahit lon.

Behechala da it teren memanan, nehorin dekayymin al elef veribbo ribbevan deikrun gefanim, veelef veribbo ribbevan deikrun rimmonim, vechullehu kayymin bachavivuta, veillen innun deaale rechimuta ben yisrael letatta, vekudesha berich hu leella. vechullehu mitare rechimuta, vekayyman birchimu. vechad atar rechimu mittatta leella, umeella letatta, keden itmalya hechala, da, mikkamma tavin, mikkamma chasadin, mikkamma rachamin ucheden rechimu diltatta, go rechimu illaa, itdabbak da beda.

Mehacha nafke teren memanan, veikrun ahava, al shema dehechala. veillen kayymin leashgacha al kol innun dimyachde yichuda demarehon birchimu, umasre nafshayyhu aleh birchimu, vesalke veashidu leella vechol innun deavde chesed bealma, innun chasadin sallekin vealin go hay hechala, umitattere tamman, vesalke leitattera go ahava illaa. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 108:5) ki gadol meal shamayim chasdecha. behechala da ketiv, (Shir HaShirim 8:7) mayim rabbim lo yuchelu lechabbot et haahava uneharot lo yishtefuha vegomer.

Hechal haratzon 1081 hechala shetitaa. da hu hechala deikre hechala deratzon, deihu raava, deikre (Devarim 8:3) motza fi Adonai, chedva deitdabbekuta decholla. vehacha ihu raava deraavin, beraza dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 4:3) kechut hashshani siftotayich. raava dechol nishmatin, denafke mehahu motza fi Adonai.

Hay hechala, hechala deraava. dekayyman hacha kol sheeltin, vechol bautin dealma. begin deraava dechol raavin, kad neshikin ishtechachu, beraza dichtiv, (Bereshit 29:11) vyyishshak yaakov lerachel. ucheden kad nashik da leda, keden ikre et ratzon. begin deha keden shelimu ishtechach, vechol anfin nehirin. vechad tzelotin sallekin, keden ihu et ratzon leishtachcha, veal da ketiv (Tehillim 69:14) vaani tefillati lecha Adonai et ratzon. deihu chibbura da im da.

Behechala da kayyman shit pitchin, 4 pitchin led sitrin dealma, vechad leella, vechad letatta. beillen pitchin itmana chad rucha, deihu rav al kullehu di memanan bechol illen pitchin, veraziel shemeh. vehay itmana veitpekad bechol innun razin illain, defuma lefuma memallan, denashkin da dela birchimu dirchimuta.

Razin illen la kayyman legallaa, aval kad tarin itpetachu, keden yadin kullehu hechalin, vechol innun ruchin, vechol innun mashshiryayn, deha tare deratzon itpetachu. vela alin beillen tarin, ella raave ditzlotin, raave dishvacha, raave denishmatin kadishin illain.
Hay ihu hechala demoshe, behay hechala itkenish moshe birchimu, venashik neshikin. behay hechala, (Shemot 19:19) moshe yedabber vehaelohim yaannnu vekol.
1005: Da im da, veal da ketiv, (Shir HaShirim 1:2) yishshakeni minneshikot pihu vegomer. let neshikin dechedva urechimuta ella kad mitdabbekan da beda, puma befuma, rucha berucha, dichden ravavn da im da, betafnukin decholla, uvechedva, minnehiru illaa.

Ta chaze, moshe yedabber, dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 1:15) hinnach yafa rayati, uchetiv (Shir HaShirim 4:3) kechut hashshani siftotayich. vehaelohim yaanennu vekol, dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 1:16) hinnecha yafe dodi af naim, uchetiv (Shir HaShirim Adonai:13) siftotav shoshannim notfot mor over.

Hay rucha, itmesaru bideh, kol razin deinnun nishmatin illain, demitare tiuveta dirchimu dilella vetatta kachada. innun nishmatin illain, kegon ribbi akiva vechavroy, deillen la itkerivu leistachaa binhar dinur, kema dishar nishmatin istachyayn tamman veavru beh, veha okimna.

(401 Chaze), rucha da, afik teresar nehorin, vechullehu kayyme beraza ditchot hay rucha. bearba sitrin dealma, kayymin 4 nehorin illain, deshaltin learba sitrin. besitra dedarom, kayyeyma chad nehora illaa yemina dechol alma, deha minneh sharan yisrael leitachada beraza dimhemnuta, veihu michael, rav chela dinhora illaa, denachta missitra dedarom, detamman nehora kayyeyma betukepeh.

Hay michael, nehora yemina, afatrofosa rabba deyisrael. begin, dechad sitra achara kayyeyma leastaa alayyhu deyisrael, keden michael taan immeh, veitavid sannegorya alayyhu deyisrael, veishtezivan mehahu kategorya demare baale devavu deyisrael.

Bar bezimna deichrav yerushalam, deha keden itgabbaru chovin umichael la yachil bahadeh desitra achara, detaanateh demichael tevira alayyhu deyisrael, ucheden (Eicha 2:3) heshiv achor yemino mippene oyev.

Besitra detzafon, kayyeyma nehora achara, deha ihu kayyeyma (sefer acher lenatla) levattela dina mibbe hechala reviaa. veyahav lammana defitcha divhahu pitcha kayyeyma memanan acharan deinnun devistar mesaava, mechakkan lehahu memana venatle dina. ulezimnin dehay nehora devsitra detzafon, ihu avid dina, vela yitmesar bida desitra achara. begin dechol dinin deitavedu beh, it lon asvavta. vekudesha berich hu avid chesed beinnun atre.

Gavriel ihu hay nehora divsitra detzafon, uvechol atar deihu mache, share beh chesed. begin degavriel bitren sitrin, kalil betarvavyyhu, veal da, machya veasvavta beh. besitra da kayyeyma raza dichtiv, (Devarim 8:Adonai) ki kaasher yeyasser ish et beno Adonai elohecha meyasserekka. veillen yissurin dirchimuta, dichlilan besitra da uvesitra da.

Besitra demizrach, kayyeyma nehora achara, deihu kayyeyma bechol mille deasvavta, lemeal kamme mareh, kol innun deitnashyayn beve marayyhu, ulekarva zimnin vekitzin leinnun marin deishtelimu mehemnutayyhu. veaschar alma bechol yoma veyoma, begin leashlema asvavta befikkuda demarih, vehay (ihu) nehora refael shemeh. veaf al gav deha okimna leh lesitra achara. veda achid lesitra da, ulesitra da, lesitra demichael, ulesitra degavriel.

Vehay ihu memana, beshaata deitdan bar nash behechala reviaa lachayyim, keden ihu akdim beasvavta. vehay asvavta miggo dechiku nafka, begin demitteren sitrin nafka, vehay dechiku atya miggo setar semala, veasvavta miggo setar yemina. veal da, hahu mera kad atya leh asvavta, miggo dechiku saggi atya leh.

Vehachi hu missitra demaarav, veaf al gav deamaran dirfael bistar mizrach, veukemuha bistar da demaarav, asvavta vechayyin lav ihu ella missetar mizrach, deha (246 amud bet) mitamman itmashshechan chayyin letata.

(Uvehay sitra dimarav), nehora chad venuriel shemeh, veihu uriel. veda ihu kalil mikkullehu, vekayyeyma shelicha becholla. veit leh 3 sitrin, aval teren innun, begin dechol chad meillen kalil bechavreh,
1006: Deinnun arba yesodin tattain, meinnun arba yesode alma, illain al kolla. uvegin dechullehu mitkashsheran da beda, ramaz kera veamar, (Shir HaShirim 6:11) el ginnat egoz yaradti lirot.

Innun teresar nehorin, kayymin behahu rucha dekamran, vehahu rucha alayyhu bishlimu, illen arba nehorin illain, it techotayyhu temanya acharanin, lemeheve bishlimu, uvechullehu shelimu chad (yaradti lirot illen arba nehorin illain it techotayyhu temanya acharanin veinnun teresar nehorin dekaymin techot hahu rucha dekaamaran vehahu rucha alayyhu bishlimu lemeheve bechullehu shelimu chad), vechad mitparshin kullehu, innun telat lechol setar.

Illen arba samchin, kayymin lesalleka uleitachada hay hechala leella, baatar deikre shamayim, leitchabbera neshikin illen beillen kachada. techot illen, kama dargin ledargin, kullehu nafke minnayyhu, meillen yesodin tattain, minnayyhu missitra demayya, uminnayyhu missitra deeshsha, uminnayyhu missitra derucha, uminnayyhu missitra deafra.

Kegavvna da taninan, arbaa nichnesu lappardes, vechullehu itberiru leducheta da, leillen arba yesode. vechol chad vechad itkashshar beducheteh, da besitra deeshsha, veda besitra demayya, veda besitra derucha, veda besitra deafra. vechullehu atbau bisoda dileh, kema deaalu. bar hahu shelema chasida, deatya besitra dimina, veitdabbak bimina, vesalik leella.

Vechad mata lehay atar deikre hechol ahava, itdabbak beh biru delibba. amar, hay hechala, tzericha ihu ledabbeka leh, behechala dilella, beahava rabba. keden ishtelim beraza dimhemnuta, veihu salik veashlim ahava zuta beahava rabba, kadka chaze. veal da mit beahava, venafak nishmateh behay kera, (Devarim 6) veahavta. zakkaa chulakeh.

Kol innun acharanin, nachtu letata kol chad vechad, veitanashu behahu yesoda denachat letata. elisha nachat letata bistar semala, deihu eshsha, venachit beh vela salik, veira behahu sitra achara, deikre el acher. veitmena minneh teshuva, veittarach begin deitdabbak beh, veal da ikre acher, veokimna.
Ben azay, nachit bisoda deafra, vead la mata leokidu deafra, demate lehahu setar achara, atva behahu afra, umit. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 116:15) yakar beene Adonai hammavta lachasidav.

Ben zoma, nachit bisoda derucha, veira berucha achara, demata listar mesaava, deikre pega ra, uvegin kach paga beh, vela ityayshav beh, vechullehu la ishtezavan meonsha. veal da amar shelomo, (Kohelet 8:14) yesh hevel asher naasa al haaretz asher yesh tzaddikim shemmagia alehem kemaase harshaim. begin deillen nachtu bedargin illen, veitanashu.

Ta chaze, begin deribbi akiva salik leella kedka yeot, al bishlam venafak bishlam. david shail sheelta, vela itperash, dichtiv (Tehillim 17:14) mimtim yadcha Adonai mimtim mecheled chelkam bachayyim. (sefer acher tohe) al ma da illen deitketalu bekatule alma tzadikayyay, zakkain dela chavu chova begin deyitanshun. ta chaze, mimtim yadcha Adonai, mimtim mecheled chelkam bachayyim, hacha ihu tere sitre, yadcha Adonai. vecheled. yadcha Adonai, da kudesha berich hu, denishmeta itkenish legabbeh. mimtim mecheled, da sitra achara, degufa ihu shalta aloy, dichtiv (Yeshayahu 38:11) lo abbit adam od im yoshve chadel.
Ta chaze, nishmeta deillen, leashlamuta derucha kadisha, dilhon asara ruchin mittata kedka yeot, vegufa dilhon yitmesar lemalchu chayyayva. kol chad natil chulakeh, beraza dekarbenin.

Veta chaze, resha sheruta dimhemnuta, go machashava, batash butzina dekardinuta, vesalik go machashava, (sefer acher veappik) nitzotzin, netzitzin zarik (Vayikra 292 amud bet) litlat mea veesrin evar, uvarir pesolet miggo machashava, veitberir.

Uf hachi, kegavvna da salik bemachashava, kema deitberar beh pesolet, (sefer acher vaytaberayr uf hachi, illen behu ishtelim man deitzterich, vadday kach salik bemachashava vecholla) veyitberir illen, behu ishtelim man deitzterich, vday kad salik, bemachashava salik vecholla
1007: Kema deitzterich. chidu missitra da, vaatzivu missitra da.

Ketiv (Kohelet 8:15) veshibbachti ani et hassimcha asher en tov laadam tachat hashshemesh ki im leechol velishtot velismoach vehu yilvennu baamalo yeme chayav asher natan lo haelohim tachat hashshamesh. veshibbachti ani et hassimcha, vechi shelomo malka meshabbach da. ella veshibbachti ani et hassimcha, da chedvavta demalka kadisha, bezimna deihu shalta, beshabbeta uveyomin tavin, demikkol ovadin tavin debar nash avid, en tov laadam tachat hashshemesh, ki im leechol velishtot, uleachzaa chedvavta behahu, (nusach acher zimna) sitra begin diyhe leh chulaka lealma deate.

Vehu yilvennu baamalo. man. da kudesha berich hu, hu yilvennu, veyehach immeh leaala leh lealma deate. davar acher vehu yilvennu, man hu. hahu bar nash deachil veshate vechade, kol may deafik lemechal ulemishte, hu yilvennu lekudesha berich hu behalevaa, veihu yahiv leh kifle kiflayim, mikkol ma deafik behay. bitren illen, ozif bar nash lekudesha berich hu, kad chayyis leh lemiskena. vechad afik beshabbate vezimne. deha kolla ozif lekudesha berich hu, kema deat amer (Mishlei 19:17) malve Adonai chonen dal ugemullo yeshallem lo.

Uvegin kach, da simcha, veda atzivu. da chayyim veda mavet. da tov, veda ra, da gan eden, veda gehinnam. vecholla, da behippucha deda, veal da gufa dilhon hava baatzivu, venishmeta bechedva. vechad havo illen asara deikrun haruge malchut, harugim havo missitra achara, veashlimu atar achara dikdushsha. uvegin kach, kolla galle kame kudesha berich hu, veitavid kedka yeot.
Behechala da kayymin innun teresar. arba illen leella, utemanya immehon. begin dechol chad, natil immeh terin, kema deihu sidura (ditren) didgalim vechen besidura diltatta, ad sof dechol dargin.

Behechala da, alin kol innun tzelotin, vechol innun raavin dishvachin deitavedu birchimu, vechad alin behay hechala, kullehu mitdabbekan beh. (bekudesha berich hu) uvechol yoma, uvechol zimna denshikin itchabbaru, keden ihu zimna, dekudesha berich hu ishtasha benishmatin detzaddikayyay, umahu hashashua demitarin innun neshikin, veinnun akdimu lehahu innuga, veal da ketiv (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai, veokimna.

Hechala da, kelala dechol innun hechalin tattain, kullehu kelilan behay hechala. hechala kadmaa, detamman kayyeyma hahu rucha dekamran, vechol innun chevavn deveh, istemich bitren samchin listar mizrach, uvitren samchin listar darom, uvitren samchin listar maarav, uvitren samchin listar tzafon, veinnun temanya. veillen ikrun yetedot hammishkan, vekayyme levar.

Kad malka illaa ate, natle innun yetedot, veitakran meatrayyhu innun metarim, deinnun temanya acharanin, bar meinnun yetedot deka amaran. vehahu rucha kadmaa di bego hechala da, kadim veal, veitkelil bego hahu (sefer acher tinyayna berucha achara deveh) rucha tinyayna deveh.

Innun teren samchin delistar mizrach, innun kariel, deitmana levar al teresar alfe memanan, dechullehu ikrun yetedot hammishkan, da limina. lismala shamiel, veitmana al teresar alfe memanan acharanin, vechullehu yetedot kidkamran. (inun memanan acharanin) samchin deitmanun listar darom, chad saadiel, vechad setariel, (nusach acher 376) kol chad vechad, al teresar alfe memanan acharanin. illen la itadun mishuletanehon lealmin.

Illen kullehu, memanan al kiuma dealma, illen (meinnun dekayymin bekiyyuma deinnun daatanesaybav dashekaley 0 bematkela davekareyn venukevin da im da) (sefer acher inun datekaley bematkela dechurin venukevin, leitnasseva da im da). veillen ikrun moznayim, al da ketiv, (Tehillim 62:10) bemoznayim laalot, vela innun dichtiv behu (252 amud alef) (Vayikra 19:36) mozne tzedek, dekamran. kol innun dishkilin da im da, vela shakil da yatir min da, sallekin veitchabberan kachada, veinnun chibbura
1008: Didchar venukeba kachada, veal da bemoznayim laalot. veaf al gav dilzimnin mistayyeya milleta, veshakil da yatir min da, sallekin umitchabberan kachada, veha okimna.

Innun teren samchin delistar tzafon, patchiel, atariel. umemanan kol chad vechad, al teresar alfin memanan acharanin, veinnun yetedot hammishchan, uveillen acharanin dekamran. innun memanan teren samchin acharanin delistar maarav, innun pedatiel tomihael, veitmenun kol chad al teresar alfe memanan acharanin, vechullehu yetedot hammishkan kidkamran.

Illen innun deoshde dimin, al kol innun dimtarche neshehon kamayyta. begin deinnun sheva birchan deitmesaru lah, itadan, vela itkeyyaymu, begin deittaracha, vela itdevaku balah veitteta kachada. veal da kullehu oshde dimin, deachze tiruchin, deinnun sheva birchan kema deitaddan meatar achara. keden behahi shaata kala nafak veamar, (Yeshayahu 50:1) e ze sefer keritut immechem asher shillachtiha.

Hechala tinyayna, deka amaran dechalil lehechala kadmaa, leityaychada beh. vechol innun chevavn, hachi name it leh temanya samchin kekadmae. vechulehu memanan, kol chad vechad, al teresar alfe memanan acharanin, keillen kadmae kidkamran. teren samchin innun listar mizrach, teren samchin listar darom, uteren samchin listar tzafon, uteren samchin listar maarav.

Illen teren samchin delistar mizrach, yehadaniel, gezuriyya. teresar alfe memanan dechol chad, vechullehu yetedot. innun teren samchin delistar darom, ahariel, barhiel. kol chad vechad, innun al teresar alfin kekadmae.

Illen memanan al mashber, venatle innun kale denashin, umanchan lon kame hahu hechala. vechad hahu sitra achara ate lekatrega behay shaata, deihu shaata desakkana, kayyme illen, vealin hane kale lammana deal pitcha, vela yachil hahu sitra achara lekatrega. ulezimnin dekadim hahu setar achara veal vekatrig, veyachil lenazkaa.

Illen teren samchin delistar tzafon, chalchaliel (sefer acher 221), karsafihael, innun memanan kol chad al teresar alfin acharanin. delistar maarav innun, sugadya (sefer acher 280). gedarya. veillen al teresar alfe acharanin.

Veillen memanan al hahu dama divrit, kad itgezar hahu valda litmanyya yomin veillen natle hahu dama, umanchan leh kame hay hechala. vechad rugeza atar bealma, ashgach kudesha berich hu al hahu dama, vela ityeyhiv lehahu sitra achara reshu leaala tamman.

Ta chaze, bezimna deitgezar hahu bar nash litmanyya yomin, vesharat aleh shabbat, malchut kadisha, hahi arla degazrin veshadan leh levar, keden kayyeyma hahu sitra achara, vechama dehay ihu chulakeh mikkarbena da, keden itbar, vela yachil leshalletaa ulekatrega aloy, vesalik veitavad sannegorya al yisrael, kame kudesha berich hu.

Hechala telitaa. hechala da dekayyeyma leachlela, uleyachada beh hahu hechala tinyayna, vehahu rucha, vechol innun chevavn deveh, kullehu kelilan veityaychadan da beda. veinnun chad rucha dechalil da beda, hachi name it leh temanya samchin, learba sitrin dealma, vechullehu ikrun yetedot hammishkan. teren samchin delistar darom, innun shachniel, azuzeya. (sefer acher veinnun memanan al teresar alfe memanan acharanin kol chad keinnun acharanin) teren samchin delistar mizrach, yehodiya azriel. veillen kayyme kol chad vechad, al 12 alfe memanan acharanin, vechullehu ikrun yetedot hammishkan.

Veillen itmanun al hahu haval detinokot delaan beorayyta, lekayyeyma alma. veillen natle hahu haval, vesalke leh leella. vechol haval vahaval deinnun tinokot delaan beorayyta lekayyeyma alma, itavid minneh rucha chada, vesalleka hahu rucha leella, veitattar beatara kadisha, veitmana netura dealma, vechen kullehu.
Teren samchin deinnun listar tzafon, azpiel (sefer acher 445), ketatarihael. veinnun memanan
1009: Al teresar alfe memanan acharanin kol chad vechad kidkamran. teren samchin delistar maarav, innun asisniyyah, adiririyya (nusach acher 230). veillen memanan al teresar alfin memanan acharanin, kol chad vechad kidkamran.

Illen itmanun leachreza bechol rekiin, lechol innun dimavrin benayyhu meorayyta, vesallekin lon dela yilun bah, keden nafke kol hane memanan umachrize veamre, vavy liflanaya deabar bereh meorayyta, vavy leh deka itavid mealma den, umealma deate.

Hechala reviaa. hechala da hechala dekayyeyma binhiru yatir. hechala da, sacharin leh telatin uteren yetedot illain, vechamesh mea elef acharanin dimmanan techot illen. vearba acharanin, illain al kullehu, vechullehu yetedot dehechala da. illen arba innun: chasdihael. kasiriyyah (nusach acher 179). kedumeyyah. dahariel. illen arba memanan al kullehu, vechullehu acharanin, kullehu memanan techotayyhu.

Veal yeda deillen, ityeda dina lemebad bealma, veal illen ketiv (Daniel 4:14) umeamar kaddishin sheelta. lehani arba, atyayn kol innun chayyaylin, di memanan al dina, leshaala hech itgezar dina bealma. kol innun dinin dela ityeyhivu befitkin, lekiyyuma dealma, veal da kullehu atyayn leshaala. uvegin kach kullehu memanan al da.

Innun telatin uteren acharanin, innun memanan al kol innun delaan beorayyta tadir, vela paske bimama uvelelya, veillen acharanin kullehu ditchotayyhu, innun memanan al kol innun dekavin zimnin yedian leorayyta. veal da innun memanan kullehu, uleanesha kullehu, lechol innun deyachle leishtadla beorayyta, vela mishtadle.

Hechala chamishaa. hechala da, kayymin beh telat mea veshittin vechamesh memanan, kechushevan yeme shatta. veella minnayyhu arba samchin illain al kullehu. veillen innun: kerashihael. sartihael. asiriyya. kadmiel. veillen ikrun yetedot dehechala da.

Illen itmenun levadcha alma (illen). kad nishmeta itosfat meerev shabbat leerev shabbat. veihi nafkat, kad ihi nafkat, nafkin illen immah, umeavre miyisrael kol atzivu, vechol yegia, vechol meriru denafsha, vechol rugeza dealma, veillen innun bediche alma.

Kol innun diltatta meillen arbaa, kullehu itmanun leabera dina, meinnun mare dedina, umeinnun detarde lon begehinnam, disalkun dina minnayyhu. veal da, kol illen yetedot kullehu kayyme bechedva, umechedva nafke, vechullehu hechalin kayyme leitatra leella. kema deittemar.

Hechala shetitaa. hechala da, hechala dekayyeyma al kol hechalin tatain. behay, mea acharanin dekayyeyman levar, deikrun yetedot keinnun acharanin. veinnun mea listar yemina, umea acharanin listar semala.

Teren memanan illain listar yemina, uteren memanan acharanin illain listar semala. illen dimina innun: malkiel. shemayahel. veillen dismala, ikrun misarsaniyyah. tzaftzafiyyah. illen innun yetedot illain, mimina umissemala.

Veillen innun kayyme uzeminin bealma. behahu zimna, detzaddika mata zimneh leistalleka mealma, veityeyhiv reshu lesitra achara. illen arba kayyme leitatda tamman, begin detifuk nishmateh binshika, vela titztaer beshuletanu desitra achara. zakkain innun tzadikayyay bealma den, uvealma deate. demarehon akdim alayyhu shuletanehon, lemehevi netiran bealma den, uvealma deate.

Mehechala da, sharan kol razin, vechol dargin illain vetatain, leitchabbera. begin deyishtechach kolla ella vetata bishlimu, lemehve kolla chad, vechibbura chad, leityaychada shema kadisha kedka yeot, uleishtalma, leanhara negidu illaa betataa, (nusach acher lenagda naheyrey illaa letatta) unehiru devutzinin kechad, (nusach acher venahare butzinin kullehu kachada) dela tade da min da. ucheden nagid veitmeshach man deitmeshach, dela ityeda vela itgalyay, begin deyitkarev (nusach acher daytakedash)
1010: Veyityayched da im da, lemeheve kolla beyichuda shelim kedka yeot.

Zakkaa chulakeh, man deyada berazin demareh, leishtemoda leh kedka yeot. deha innun achlin chulakehon bealma den, uvealma deate. al da ketiv (Yeshayahu 65:13) hinne avaday yochelu. zakkain innun tzadikayyay demishtadle beorayyta yemama velele. begin deinnun yade orchoy dekudesha berich hu, veyade leyachada yichuda kaddisha kedka yeot, dechol deyada leyachada shema kaddisha bishlimu kadka chaze, zakkaa ihu bealma den, uvealma deate.

Kishshura dechol hane hechalin, hacha mitkashsheran. (yaakov keshiru dechol mehemanuta ruach dekayyeyma lekabbela ruach deihu letatta vehay rucha deihu leella kayyeyma lekabbela ruach ilaa dechol ruchin kayymin beh da ihu yaakov deihu ruach emtzaita dechol ruchin veihu natil hay hechala shetitaa beinnun neshikin leitdabbeka rucha berucha kema deat amar 0 yashkeni minneshikot pihu, vechol neshika ihu 1) leitdabbeka rucha berucha, tataa beillaa. uveillen neshikin istallak rucha diltata leitdabbeka berucha dilella. vechad mitdabbekan rucha berucha, keden rucha illaa setimaa shaari al hay rucha deemtzaita. vead la atar leitdabbeka rucha berucha, rucha illaa. la sharya al (hahi) rucha deemtzaita.

Veraza da, kad itachid rucha berucha, keden sharan neshikin leitchabbera umitarin shear shayyfin betiuveta, verucha da mitdabbeka beda. ucheden, shayyfin kullehu mitare illen beillen, leitkashshera shayyfa beshayyfeh.

Vei tema, man atar shayyfe tatae, o shayyfe illae. shayyfe tatae mitare tadir legabbe illae, man deihu bachashocha, taiv tadir lemeheve binhora. shalhova uchama diltata, atar tadir legabbe (Bereshit nusach acher amud alef) shalhova chivvavra dilella, begin leitdabbeka beh, ulemishre techoteh, veraza da, (tehillim fag 1) elohim al domi lach al techorash veal tishkot el.

Kad natil yaakov hay hechala shetitaa, keden ikre (213 amud alef) bishma kadisha illaa shelema, vaAdonai. vei tema shelema decholla. lav hachi, ella kad ishtelimu kullehu hechalin illen beillen, keden ikre kolla bishma shelim, Adonai elohim. veda hu (258 amud bet, Bereshit 78 amud alef) shema shelim mikkolla. vead la itchabberu da im da, hechalin behechalin, la ikre bishma shelema da. vechad mitchabberan kachada illen beillen, keden ishtelim kolla meella vetata. unehiru deella leella, nachta vesharya al kolla, veitkashar kolla kachada, lemeheve kolla chad.

Veraza demilla, yaakov natil arba nashin, vechalil lon begaveh. veaf al gav deokimna lehay milla beraza achara, deihu kayyeyma ben (vayyetze 153 amud bet) teren almin. veraza decholla, kad yaakov natil hay hechala, deihu shetitaa, natil vechalil begavveh kol innun arba nashin, arba malachin, vechullehu davke behechala da. illen innun (254 amud alef) arba reshe naharin, dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:10) umishsham yippared vehaya learbaa rashim. illen arba reshin, innun arba nashin natil lon yaakov, (kidkamran veleh itzterich veihu) natil hechala da.

Ucheden ikre hay hechala vaAdonai, kad ihu letav kema deat amer (Shemot 13:21) vaAdonai holech lifnehem yomam. (Bereshit 18:17) vaAdonai amar hamechasse ani meavraham. vechad itchabbar yitzchak, behechala deve dina, deikre zechuta, keden ikre kolla vaAdonai, leanesha lechayyayvayya, kema deat amer (Bereshit 19:24) vaAdonai himtir al sedom vegomer, vecholla beraza chada kedka yeot.

Vechad yaakov natil hechala da, keden ikre kolla ratzon shalom. (vesimanich 0 uvehaggia tor Ester) veda hu et ratzon. umikkan ulehala, sharan hechalin leitchabbera uleitkashshera illen beillen. veaf al gav detanenan (Vayikra 120 amud alef) deromit mizrachit. vecholla ihu kachada, hacha ihu rucha berucha, devekuta chada.

Mikkan share avraham, deihu yemina, deikre ahava (Rabba dekaamaran. veihu natil hechala deikre 13). keden, (Yechezkel 16:7) shadayim nachonu, veitmalleyayn michol tuv, lesappaka uleatzena kolla mehacha. vechad illen (pikkude 253 amud alef) shadayim nachonu veitmalleyayn migo rechimu illaa, keden ikre hechala da el shadday kidkamran. uvehay istappak kol
1011: Alma kad itbere. deha kad itbere alma, la yachil lemekam bekiyyuma, vela hava kaim, ad deitgele hechala da denatil avraham, vechad itgele avraham behay hechala, (nusach acher kede lealma dihe sippuka vechulei) keden amar lealma day, ha sippuka leatzena minneh alma uleitkayyeyma. uvegin kach, el shadday ikre, el shadday lecholla beh. (nusach acher valeatezaneh minneh ta chaze hechala da zammin vechulei).

Vezammin kudesha berich hu lemalyya leh, (nusach acher beh) uleatkena leh lezimna deate dichtiv (Yeshayahu 66:11) lemaan tinku usevatem missod tanchumeha lemaan tamotztzu vehitannagtem mizziz kevodah. shod tanchumeha veziz kevodah, kolla ihu behay hechala. ucheden behahu zimna ketiv, (Bereshit 21:7) mi millel leavraham henika vanim sara, deha yenika talya beh beavraham.

Yitzchak deihu semala dekudesha berich hu, atar deminneh mitarin kol dinin dealma, veihu deroa dismala, sheruta dechol dinin, vechol dinin mitare mitamman, hay ihu natil veachid hahu hechala deikre zechuta, leitchabbera dina bedina, ulemeheve kolla kishshura chada, begin dehay ihu dina dilella, ureshimin dedinin kayymin beh.

Vehacha itreshim shema kadisha, deikre elohim. begin deit elohim chayyim, deihu leella leella, satim mikkolla. veit elohim, deihu be dina dilella. velohim, deihu be dina diltata. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 58:12) ach yesh elohim shoftim baaretz. elohim illaa, raza deelohim chayyim, kalil leillen diltata, vecholla ihu chad.

Behay hechala, atar yitzchak, vechullehu shivin uteren nehorin dichlilan beh, deminnayyhu itgezaru kol dinin (sefer acher dealma diltatta) diltata dealma, dichtiv, (Daniel 4:14) bigzerat irin pitgama. vaamay ikrun irin. ella begin dechullehu kayymin behay ir. (Tehillim 48:9) ir Adonai tzevaot. ir elohenu. kol innun hechalin leella, kol chad vechad ikre ir, kema deat amer (Daniel 4:10) ir vekaddish. veillen innun irin, dekayymin lego bego dehechala, dekayymin beir, begin kach ikrun irin.

Hay hechala, itkelil beyitzchak, vecholla ihu behechala deavraham, begin dimina achlil lismala. veta chaze, kol chad vechad kalil lechavreh. veha okimna, debgin da avraham akad leyitzchak, begin leachlela beh dina, (nusach acher bimina) uleishtachcha semala kalil bimina (sefer acher uleishtakkecha yemina al semala valeashelatea vechulei) uleashleta yemina al semala.

Veal da kudesha berich hu pakid leh leavraham, lekarva bereh ledina, uleatkafa aloy, vela pakid leyitzchak, ella leavraham. veal da ishtechach, da bedina, veda bechesed, vecholla chad, veitkelil da beda. vehachi, itkelilu hechalin tatain beillain.

Kad natil yitzchak hechala da, keden kolla ihu letav. dina bizchuta. veal da, bae bar nash dedain dina, lemedan dina bizchuta. begin deihu raza illaa, shelimu dedina. begin delet shelimu dedina, ella bizchuta, da bela da lav ihu shelimu. dina bizchuta, da ihu shelimu dimhemnuta, kegavvna dilella.

Beyoma derosh hashshana, kad dina atar bealma, baan yisrael letata, leatara rachame miggo shofar, kegavvna deraza illaa. veha okimna. uvaena lechabbera dina lokovel zechuta, begin dechad kayyeyma dina bizchuta, kolla ihu bechibbura chada. veella vetata bishlimu. ucheden, (Iyov Adonai:16) veolata kaftza piha, delet lah reshu leastaa ulekatrega bealma. ucheden kolla beyichuda chada kedka yeot. vedina bela zechu lav ihu dina.

Veda ihu deyisrael, deit lon dina bizchuta. aval shear ammin, la it lon dina bizchuta, veal da asir lan, lesaddera dinin dilan bearkae deammin ovde avoda zara, deha let lon chulaka bistar mehemnuta dilan. dichtiv, (Tehillim 147:20) la asa chen lechol goy umishpatim bal yedaum. umissitra deyisrael kol man dedain dina, vela achlil beh zechut, da ihu chate, deka gara raza dimhemnuta, veaste garmeh lehahu sitra, deit beh dina bela zechut.

Veta chaze, kad kayyme sanhedrin letata, lemedan dine nefashot, itzterichu lemiftach bizchuta. begin leachlela zechuta bedina. vetu, deha ikrun mibbe (251 amud alef) zechuta. veal da, ishtaddeluta dilhon, lemiftach bizchuta, vesharan bizchuta mizzeera, ulevatar ishtelim dina meillaa. lemeheve zechuta kalil bedina. da leella, veda letata. dina bizchuta, shelimu dedina. da bela da, lav ihu shelimu. uvegin kach, yitzchak
1012: Verivka kachada innun, da dina, veda zechuta, lemeheve shelimu kachada. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, dekudesha berich hu yahav lon orayyta shelemata, lemehach beorach keshot, kegavvna dilella.

Ta chaze, deinnun la dayynin dina, ella bizchu, uleayyna zechuta bekadmita, lemehve kalil da beda. vesanhedrin ka mehappeche bizchuta bedina, leachlela kolla kachada, begin dela yishlot sitra achara. deha kad zechuta la ishtechach, sitra achara ishtechach, deikre chova, veitchabberat bedina, veitatkefat veda hu dina bechova.

Veal da, beyoma derosh hashshana, baena lechabbera zechuta bedina, vela yitgabbar chova. uvegin kach, baena zechuta vedina lemeheve kachada, begin deihu shelim. dechad sitra achara shalta, lav ihu shelim, ella kitruga, kema deihu kitruga, veinnun arba mitot, vechad sitra deihu zechut shalta, kolla ihu shelim, (Melachim 2 20:19) shalom veemet (Tehillim 103:4) chesed verachamim.

Vechad itchabberat sitra achara bedina, shalta bekitruga, beinnun arba mitot vayit din: sekila, serefa, hereg, vechenk. kullehu shuletanuta dekitruga bisha. sekila, begin deihu (yeshaya 8) even negef. serefa, begin deihu (Yeshayahu 8:14) tzur michshol, eshsha takifa. herg, da (Devarim 32:42) cherev tochal basar. tochal basar vaday, deshalta (338 170 amud alef) bevisra, veda hu (Bereshit 6:13) ketz kol basar. chenek, begin deihu (Devarim 21:23) killelat elohim, hahu deshalta al chenek, al tzelivu. veokimna, begin dela yishtear ella bisra bilchodoy, vehahu killelat elohim, shalta bevisra, mara chashocha. uvegin kach, da letav veda levish.

Veitzterichu yisrael deraza dimhemnuta behu, leistamra, begin deyishlot sitra dimhemnuta, vela yahavun ducheta lesitra achara leshalletaa zakkain innun bealma den, uvealma deate, alayyhu ketiv (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kullam tzaddikim vegomer.

Neviin, deinnun sitrin illain, teren yarchin desamchin leorayyta kadisha, innun natlin lehechala ditren ruchin beh, deinnun noga vezohar. veinnun teren yarchin letata, lesamcha leinnun hechalin dilella, deikrun tora shebbeal pe. kema deit samchin leorayyta deihi tora shebbichtav, kach it samchin kayymin leorayyta deihi tora shebbeal pe. veitchelilu da beda. keden illen teren samchin diltatta, kad mitchabberan beillen illain, itreshim behu sitra dinvua, uman ihu. (247) mare, deihu kegavvna dinvua.

Vechol innun marehon demare, mehacha yankin. leella nevua, hacha mare. veal da, ihu da kegavvna da, veda kegavvna da. vechad mitchabberan da beda, keden shallit al hay atar, (itreshim) shema kadisha, deikre tzevaot. begin dechol innun chayyaylin kadishin, kullehu kayyme hacha, vechullehu ikrun missitra dinvua, mare vechelma missitra dinvua havo.

Veaf al gav deka amrenan, di bego hahu ot kayyayma kaddisha, sharya shema da. begin dekullehu chayyaylin nafke mehay ot. im kol da, yarchin deinnun kayymin levar, karenan al shema da, veillen innun deikrun barayyte, deha barayyta levar mimmishna. matnitin kayyeyma lego barayyte, veikrun yarchin batte baray, kegavvna di leella.

Matnitin ihu raza dekayyeyma lego, deolfe tamman ikkara decholla, veal tanae, veraza (da) dehach, (Shir HaShirim 8:2) enhagcha aviacha el bet immi telammedeni. el bet immi: da kodesh hakkadashim. telammedeni: da hu raza dematnitin. dechad al da nahar denagid venafik, behahu bet kodesh hakkadashim, ketiv telammedeni. veda hu raza, deikre mishna. kema deat amer (Devarim 17:18) et mishne hattora hazzot.

Kad itmashshecha levar, ikre barayyta. teren yarchin innun barayyte, raza derazin dela ityeyhiv leitgallaa. begin dela itmesar raza bar lechakkime elyonin. vavy i itgele, vavy i la itgele, begin deihu raza merazin illain dekudesha berich hu anhig beh alma.
Bayit rishon kayyeyma bime shelomo, lokovel alma illaa, veihu ikre bayit rishon, veishtamash kolla bevet kodesh hakkadashim, atar deishtammesh beh shimsha
1013: Besihara. verazin illain kullehu bishlimu, vekayyeyma alma beashlemuta. ulevatar garmu chovin, veitmeshachu razin, veitdachyayn mibbet kodesh hakkadashim levar. kad itdachu leyarchin, keden kayymu levar, deikrun batte baray, veitzterichu levarayyte.

Bayit sheni kayymu bevatte baray beyarkin, uminnayyhu ahadru veshaaru (hay) bevet kodesh hakkadashim veihu bayit sheni. veinnun acharanin ishtaaru bevarayyta levar, bene yarchin. (sefer acher vehane ikkara dilhon matnitin deihu bet shene uvarayyta inun desharu beve yarchin vahavo vechulei) vahavu olfin mimmatnitin, veitnehigu minnah, vehayeynu raza dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 2:3) ki mitztziyyon tetze tora.

Ulevatar kad garmu chovin, itade shuletanuta dehay bayit sheni, (veaf al gav) deshuletana dileh la hava kevayit rishon, dehava beh shelama tadir, begin demalka dishlama dileh tadir hava begavvevy, veal da hava bishlam. bayit sheni la hava beh shelam hachi, begin dearla kitruga beh tadir, veal da havo kahane zeminin begavveh, lekatrega behay arla, ulehu itzterich milla, lekatrega bahadah, uleaggana al bayit sheni. vecholla beraza kadka chaze.

Levatar garmu chovin, veshalta hahi arla, veitdachyayn mibbayit sheni levar, venachtu mittamman lechammuke yarchin, letatta, (nusach acher ulevatar nachte mittamman vaatadechav meinnun chammuke diltatta) ad di sharun letatta beraglin. vechad yitvun beraglin, keden, (Zecharya 14:4) veamdu raglav bayom hahu, vealma becholla yitnehig beraza illaa kadka chaze. veaf al gav deitdachu vela ishtevaku minneh, ulealmin itachidu beh.

Uman deyada umadid beshiura (233 amud alef) dekav hammidda, arka dimshichu deyarkin ad raglin, yachil leminda (Vayikra 260 amud alef) meshicha degaluta deitmeshach. veraza ihu ben mechatztzede chakla, vecholla beraza illaa. uvegin da, kullehu barayyte, vechullehu tanae, vechullehu emorae, kayyme beduchetayyhu kadka chaze, illen lego, veillen levar, beinnun chammuke yarchin (veillen levar) uletatta mevarchin. uvechullehu ikre tora shebbeal pe. uvechullehu nachte yisrael veitgalu.

Ucheden kad yistayem galuta, bimshichu deraglin, keden veamdu raglav bayom hahu, veyitavar hahu rucha mesaava arla min alma, veyithadrun yisrael bilchodayyhu leshalletaa kedka yeot, begin dehahu arla, nachit lon letatta, ad hasheta. umikkan ulehala, dehay arla itketzatz veitavar miggo alma, keden (Devarim 33:28) vayishkon yisrael betach badad en yaakov. behahu en yaakov, vela ishtechach mekatrega alayyhu. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael bealma den bealma deate.

Yosef hatztzadik, ammuda dealma, ihu natil birshuta hechala tamir veganiz, uvirshuteh kayyeyma hechala sheviaa. veaf al gav deka amaran dehechala (246 amud alef, 266 amud alef, Bereshit 45 amud alef) delivnat hassappir birshuteh kayyeyma, hachi hu deveh metakken. aval ta chaze, neviim deka amaran. kad mitchabbere letatta, teren dargin mitparshin minnayyhu, mare vachalom, vekayyme beyarchin. beinnun chammukin kayyme mare, vehahu deikre nevua ketanna. meyarchin uletatta (sefer acher letatta) (262 amud alef 247 amud bet) kaim chalom, ad dematu raglin beraglin. vetamman kaim hechala tattaa veikre livnat hassappir.

Kolla yarchin beyarchin, leishtallema chad bechad, vechullehu dargin dinvua, deha mittamman nafke vesharan, veitavidu minnayyhu mare, vesharan al hay atar, veitavid minnayyhu chalom. yosef hatztzadik, ihu shelema decholla, ihu natil kolla. begin decholla itkkan begineh, kolla taiv betiuveta beginih.

Ta chaze, beshaata deyosef hatztzadik kayyeyma leatkena kolla, keden ihu natil kolla. vechad itchabbar behechaleh, keden mitare kullehu, lenatla tiuveta ureuta, illae vetattae, vecholla innun biruta chada ushelimu chad, lemechde (lemeheve) illae vetattae, reuta chada kedka yeot. vechullehu tattae kayyme bekiyyuma begineh, veal da ketiv, (Mishlei 10:25) vetzaddik yesod olam. veal hay yesoda kaim hay alma.

Hay livnat hassappir, la kaim bekiyyumeh, ad dehay yosef hatztzadik. ittakkan. vechad ihu ittakkan, kolla mittakni da hu yesoda dekullehu binyayna. veal da ketiv, (Bereshit 2:22) vayyiven Adonai elohim et hatztzela, vela ketiv vayyitzer, vela ketiv vayyivra. begin dehay kayyeyma al yesoda, ulevatar diysoda itkkan, kolla itbene
1014: Aleh. uvegin da, kullehu kayymin behay, veha okimna.

Ta chaze, ketiv (Bereshit 2:22) vayyiven Adonai elohim et hatztzela, dahavat missitra deachora, veatkin lah leahaddera anpin beanpin. hachi okimna. aval vayyiven, istakkal lesalleka lah behahu darga dealma illaa sharya beh, lemehve da kegavvna deda.

Tu vayyiven, istakkal besitroy, veatkin vechavvin kol ruchoteha, lemizra uleashkaa uleolada, lemebad lah kol tzarchoy, kema deitzterich. ulevatar vayvieha, bema. behay tzaddik. dichtiv, (261 amud alef) (Ester 2:13) uvaze hannaara baa el hammelech, dehay amshich lecholla, lesalleka leitattera bishlimu. hacha meniu dechol chovin, hacha meniu dechol tiuvetin bishin.

Ma dela ihu behahu hechala shetitaa, besitra achara, detamman kol innugin bishin, vechol sitrin detiuvetin deinnuga dehay alma, vechad hay alma itnehig behu, beni nasha kashle behu (nusach acher uvegin divne nasha taayyn behu kashlin behu) lehahu alma. dechaman kama innugin vetiuvetin, degufa ithani veitanig minnayyhu, vetayayn avatrayyhu. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 3:6) vattere haishsha ki tov haetz lemaachol vegomer. deha kol tiuvetin vechol innugin dealma beh talyayn.

Veal da, kegavvna da, it millin degufa ithane behu, veayyle legufa, vela lenishmeta. veit millin denishmeta ithane minnayyhu, vela gufa. veal da, dargin perishin da min da. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, denatle orach meshar, umane garmayyhu mehahu sitra, umitdabbekan besitra dikdusha.

Behechala da, kelilan kol shear shemahan, dechol illen hechalin (nusach acher vechayyaylin) diltatta. tere shemahan innun dichlilu shear shemahan acharanin. chad dechad itchabbar ella betatta, veyaakov natil hechaleh, beinnun neshikin, beraza illaa. keden kalil kol shear shemahan, veikre Adonai elhim, veda ikre shem malle, kema (Bereshit 48 amud bet, 246 amud bet) deokimna. vechad, kad itchabbar yesoda dealma behechaleh, vechullehu mitare bachavivuta uvetiuveta legabbeh, vechullehu kelilan beh, keden kalil shear shemahan, veikre Adonai tzevaot. veda ikre shema kaddisha shelim, velav ihu shelim kehay achara.

Ma ben hay lehay. da shallit illaa betattaa, gufa begufa (veda ihu shallit becholla) kidkamran. veda shallit meatar desiuma degufa uletatta, beinnun hechalin uvecholla diltatta, veraza da, bayit rishon uvayit sheni. uvegin da, hechala da kalil kol shear shemahan diltatta, (vechullehu shemahan kalelaynan behay shemma kullehu shemahan diltatta) kema deokimna. veal da, shemahan illen, da salleka veda nachit. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, deyadin archoy deorayyta.

Yesoda da, ittakkan litren sitrin. chad, leatkena kol shear diltatta. vechad, leatkena hechala sheviaa, uleatkena da beda, lemeheve kolla reu chada kedka yeot. ad hacha yichuda ditren sitrin, dilella vetatta, leityaychada kachada bishlimu, lemehach beorach meshar.

Zakkaa chulakeh, man deyada leyachada yichuda, ulesaddure siddura dimhemnuta, lemehach beorach meshar. zakkaa ihu behay alma, uvealma deate. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 85:11) chesed veemet nifgashu tzedek veshalom nashaku. ucheden (Tehillim 85:13) emet meeretz titzmach vetzedek mishshamayim nishkaf. gam Adonai yitten hattov veartzenu titten yevulah.

Hechal kodesh hakkodashim dizer divria hechala sheviaa. hechala da, hechala penimaa mikkol hani hechalin. hay hechala ihu setimu, delav beh diyyukena mammash, velet gufa kelal. hacha setimu dego raza derazin, hay ihu raza, deihu atar, leaala tamman bego innun tzinnorin dilella. rucha dechol ruchin, raavavn dechol raavivyn, leitchabbera kolla kachada. rucha dechayye (deha) behay, lemehve kolla tikkuna chada.
Hechala da, ikre (255 amud bet) bet kodesh hakkadashim. atar lokovla hay (sefer acher nishmeta illaa) nishmatin illain, deikre hachi, leatara alma deate legabbeh.
Hay alma olam ikre. olam: selika, desalik alma tattaa legabbe alma illaa, veistattar begavev, veitalam beh, itgalyay bistira. olam: desalik ihu, bechol innun
1015: Dekarvin beh, veistatteran go setiru illaa. olam illaa: salik veistattar biruta illaa, go temiru dechol temirin dela ityeyda kelal (kelal), vela itgele, velet man deyada leh.

Parochta defarsa perisa, chafyya go temiru satim. kapporta perisa go temirin illain, leastema setimin deha temirin usetimin. (nusach acher parochta perisa go tehirin illain distama setima dehay tamir vesatim) lego min kapporta, it atar satim vetamir veganiz, leachnasha leh begaveh. meshach revut illaa, rucha dechayye, al yeda dehahu nahar denagid venafik, vehahu nahar ikre mabbua devera, dela paskin memoy lealmin. vechad hay ayel venagid kol hahu revut kudesha milleella, meatar dekodesh hakkodashim. nehiru negidu nachit veate, go innun tzinnorin. hay itmalleyay mittamman, kenukeba demitabbera veitmalleya min dechura.

Uf hachi name hay hechala, mittakna tadir lekabbela, kenukeba dimkabbela min dechura. kabbilu dekabbilu, kol innun ruchin venishmatin kadishin denachtin lealma, veitabberu (sefer acher vaataakabev) tamman. kol hahu zimna deitzterich.

Yitakkevun ad deyete malka meshicha, veyistappekun kol innun nishmatin, veyetun veyachde alma kemillekaddemin. ucheden, yachde kudesha berich hu kemillekaddemin, kema deat amer (tehillim 104) yismach Adonai bemaasav.

Behay hechala, kayymin innugin vetafnukin deruche, veishtasheuta deishtaasha kudesha berich hu beginta deeden. hacha ihu tiuveta decholla, veinnuga decholla, leitchabbera kolla kachada, ulemeheve kolla chad, kishshura decholla beyichuda chada hacha kayyeyma.

Dechad shayyfe kullehu mitchabberan beshayyfin illain, kol chad vechad kadka chaze leh, let lon tiuveta, velet lon innuga, bar beyichuda dehay hechala, kolla hacha talya. kad itchabberuta dehacha ityaychad beyichuda chada, keden kol nehiru deshayyfin, vechol nehiru deanpin, vechol chedvavn, kullehu nehirin vechadan.

Zakkaa chulakeh, man deyada lesaddera siddurin, uleatkena tikkuni ishtalmuta kedka yeot, rechimu dekudesha berich hu behay alma, uvealma deate. ucheden, kol dinin, vechol gizrin bishin, mitabberin umitvattelin mealma.

Hechala da, hechala detiuveta, hechala deinnuga, hechala leishtashea ella vetata kachada. umekabbela kolla nehiru devutzina illaa denahir lecholla, uleityaychada kolla kedka yeot. beyichuda shelim. veal da, hechala da kaim bitmiru decholla, ganiz mikkolla. af al gav dechullehu temirin. da tamir veganiz yatir. lemeheve berit kayyayma kolla kachada, dechar venukeba lemehevi shelim.

Hechol da ikre aron habberit, deihu adon kol haaretz. begin dehay ihu atar, denafku minneh kol nishmatin dealma, leyachada yichuda letatta, uleamshacha yichuda dekudesha berich hu meella letatta, leyahava latztzadik, begin denafku (vayyetze 155 amud bet) mitzaddik, veayyle betztzaddik. ulevatar nafke mitzadik, veayyle baatar denafke mitamman.

Hay aron habberit, nakit kolla mitztzaddik. ulevatar, nafke minneh, veayyle betztzaddik letatta. levatar nafke mitztzaddik diltatta, veayyle behay aron habberit. lemeheve kol nishmatin kelilan meella umitatta. lemeheve shelim mikkol sitrin. vehay aron habberit, nakit mitztzaddik innun nishmatin, mitteren sitrin.

Ta chaze, mabbua devera la mitparsha mibbera lealmin, veal da, hay atar, shichlula decholla, kiuma dechol gufa, lemeheve shelim becholla kedka yeot. hacha, hu yichuda vekishshura kachada, lemeheve ella vetatta chad, bekishshura chada, dela mitparshan kol shayyfin da min da, uleishtachcha kolla anpin beanpin.

Veal da tanenan, man deshamish arseh meachora, achchish tikkuna deistakkeluta anpin beanpin, leanhara kolla kachada, uleishtachcha kolla anpin beanpin, bidvekuta kadka yeot, kema deat amer (Bereshit 2:24) vedavak beishto, beishto dayyka, vela achore ishto.

Teren innun, yaakov ihu leella, yosef letatta. teren tiuvetin innun. chad hechala shetitaa. vechad hay hechala sheviaa. tiuveta leella, beinnun neshikin denatil yaakov. tiuveta letatta, behay shimmusha denatil yosef. mitteren sitrin illen, natil (hay)
1016: Aron habberit rucha dechayye. missitra deyaakov, natil rucha dechayye dilella, deitdavak beh beinnun neshikin, veail (beinnun neshikin) (nusach acher veayil) rucha dechayye dilella beh, leitzena minnih. missitra deyosef, deihu letatta, besiuma degufa, behay hechala. natil ruchin venishmatin learka letatta, lehay alma.

Illen teren sitrin, mitparshan litren sitrin. sitra deyaakov, itpashat veyahiv tukepa, lenava beinnun shadayim, deitmalleyayn mehahu rucha dechayye, veyanik behu leinnun malachin kadishin, deinnun chayyin vekayymin lealmin, vekayymin bekiyyuma beh, sitra deyosef, ayiyil betiuveta veyahav tukepa lego, veavid nishmatin veruchin, lenachta letatta, uleatzena behu bene alma.

Veal da, kayymin teren sitrin illen, da leella, veda letatta. da leatzena leella, veda lemezan letatta. kol chad vechad kadka chaze leh, (veal da) vecholla ihu chad, vechad raza ihu. veim kol da, yosef zan lechol gufa, veashke leh. demehay rucha dechayye deitdabbekuta deyaakov, nachit letatta, uveh itdavak hay aron habberit, biruta leella, venachit hahu rucha dechayye letatta, behahu itdabbekuta deyosef, vechad itchabbar kolla kachada, itmalleyayn innun shadayim leyanka lecholla, uvegin kach kolla ihi chad, zakkaa chulakeh, man deyada lekashshera kishrin, uleyachada yichuda bitzlote biruta delibba kedka yeot, begin ledabbeka shayyfa beshayyfa, rucha berucha, kolla bichlala chada, lemeheve kolla chad kadka chaze.

Ta chaze, hay hechala, kad illen ruchin kadishin, vechol innun hechalin uretichin, kullehu mityaychade kachada, veishtechachu bekishshura chada, keden hay rucha illaa dechullehu, deihu nekuda chada, astim behu, vela itgalyay, veitavid rucha satim kegavvna illaa. vesimanich egoza, yichuda bekishshura decholla kidkamran, leitkashshera da beda, lemehve kolla shelim, bishlimu (dechar venukeba) kachada.

Veha okimna kegavvna da, karbena salleka leyachada (nusach acher yichuda) karbena uleyachada (davar acher valeasetapekaa) kol chad vechad kadka chaze leh mehahu tenana desalik, kahana deihu yemina, bekishshura deyichuda biruta, velevae beshirata. kalil da beda. hechala behechala, rucha berucha, ad demitchabberan beatrayyhu, shayyfa beshayyfa, lemeheve kolla kalil kachada kedka yeot.

Veha okimna dechad ishtelim kolla kachada, shayyfin illain betattain, keden, nishmeta illaa decholla, itarat, vealat bechullehu, venahir lecholla, vechullehu mitbarchan illain vetatain. vehahu dela ityeyda, vela al bechushevana, reuta dela itfas lealmin, keden kolla salik ad en sof, veitkashshar kolla bekishshura chada, uvasim, hahu reuta lego bego bistimu.

Nehiru denishmeta illaa, salleka lego bego, venahir lecholla. bego dehay nehiru, ail setimu demachashava, deihu kalil kolla, uvego lego, behahu reu demachashava, anhir veitbasam vetafis vela tafis, vesalleka (sefer acher hay reu) migo reu demachashava letafsa beh, vechad hay salik, nehiru diltatta tafis beh.

Vechen kolla, leitkashshera uleitmalleya uleitbarcha kolla kachada, kedka yeot. ucheden itkashshar da beda kadka amaran, hechalin behechalin, tattain beillain, raza dechar venukeba kachada, nehiru illaa, binhiru desatim veganiz yatir beh. vehahu deganiz, kalil bema deganiz yatir, ad deishtechach kolla kedka yeot, beyichuda chada.

Veal da, moshe hava yada lesaddera siddura demareh mikkol bene alma, kad itzterich learcha, arich. lekatztzera, katzar. kema (244 amud bet) deokimna, (Bamidbar 12:13) el na refa na lah. tanenan, man deorich bitzloteh veyistakkal beh, lesof ata lide keev lev. vetanenan, man deorich bitzloteh, yorchun yomoy.

Veraza demilla, man dearich baatar devae lekatztzera, ate lide keev lev, man lev. da hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 15:15) vetov lev mishte tamid. begin deihu atar devae lekatztzera, vela learcha beh, deha kolla kaim leella, uvae dela leamshacha leh, lekashshera leh bekishshura dilella, bela arichu lemeheve kolla
1017: Chad beyichuda chad. vechevan deitkashar kachada, keden la bae learcha bearichu, uleitchanna betachanune. vechad arich baarichu, baatar deitzterich, kudesha berich hu kabbil tzeloteh, veda hu yekara dekudesha berich hu, begin deyichuda ditzlota ka mekashsher kishrin, veasge birchan leella vetatta.

Go hechala da, kayyeyma nekuda chada temirta, vehay nekuda ihi rucha, lokovla rucha achara illaa. vechad sharya rucha berucha, keden al da beda veihu chad, udevekuta chada. veitrechiv da beda lemeheve chad, kehay ilana dearkiv da beda veihu chad, zina bezineh. vavy man dearkiv zina bela zineh, keinnun bene aharon, devau learkava ilana beachara delav ihu zineh.

Uman dearkiv zina bezineh, veyada lekashshera kishra bekishreh, hechala behechaleh, darga bedargeh, da it leh chulaka bealma deate, kema deokimna. veal da, hay ihu shelimu decholla. vechad ishtelim da beda, veihu kolla chad ovada zina bezineh denafik mehay shelimu hahu ikre maase merkava.

Veraza da (Bereshit 2:7) vayyitzer Adonai elohim et haadam, (Bereshit 48 amud bet) shem malle. veadam ihu ovada dehay merkava, dearkiv da beda, ovada dishlimu decholla, vechad ishtelim da beda, keden Adonai elohim, shem malle. zakkaa ihu man deyada lekashshera kishre mehemnuta. uleyachada yichuda kadka chaze.

Ta chaze, kema deitnehu shemahan kadishin illain, mitchabberin illen beillen, hachi ihu shema kadisha. itperash leella, veitperash letatta. shema da ihu leella, shema da ihu beemtzaita, shema da ihu letatta. Adonai deihu raza dishma kadisha, ihu chad. raza decholla. alma illaa, bistimu distimuta dealeh, deishtattef bahadeh, veihu chad. alma tattaa, bistimu deemtzaita, raza reticha kadisha illaa dealeh, veokimna. (sefer acher ta chaze raza dishma kaddisha da Adonai elohim shemma da ihu leella shemma da ihu beemtzaita shemma da ihu letatta. leella raza dealma deate bistimu distimuta dealeh veihu chad. letatta raza dealma tattaa vealma ilaa dealeh ishtattaf bahadeh veihu chad. beemtzaita beraza dirticha kaddisha ilaa veokimna)

Mehay gisa, 4 retichin nafkin, umehay gisa arba retichin nafkin, begin dechol chad vechad mitperash learba, kol reticha arba innun, kad mistakkelin dargin. vechen kullehu arba bearba, (74 denachtin darga letatta behahu atar deikre) beraza dishma kadisha deihu adonay, beinnun retichin dekayyme venatle bishma da, veinnun ikrun (Zecharya 6) hare nechoshet, begin deit harim veit harim. it harim illain, (139 amud alef) veharim tattain. veinnun bitlat sitrin kayyme, venafke miggo zahav vachesef unechoshet.

Nechoshet letatta, begin deinnun retichin denafke migo alef dalet nun yod di bego hechala kadmaa, deinnun arba retichin denafkin migo innun teren ruchin yemina usemala, miggo livnat hassafir, (246 amud alef) kidkamran. illen teren ruchin dekaamrenan hatam, innun ikrun tere turim, veinnun (233 amud alef) hare nechoshet.

Meinnun tere ruchin deikrun hare nechoshet, nafke innun 4 retichin, demishtammeshe behahu shema (246 amud bet) dealef dalet, deishteka besandalfon, mareh deappaya. vechullehu shelichan al illen bealma, beraza desusevavn uretichin, begin deit reticha al susevavn, denatle lah.

Veda shema kadisha, itkelil beYod hei, kema deokimna, deitkelil alef dalet beYod hei, veihu yeahadonahi. (246 amud bet) veha ittemar, elohim la itkelil bishma achara, begin deit elohim chayyim, umehay, itpashat lechamma sitrin, vela itkenish, ella itpashat.

Shema dechalil kol shemahan, yod hei vav hei, beraza deatvavn tzerufa dishma kadisha, deveh hava yada kahana, letzarfa bechol sitroy, ad desalke shemahan bechamma sitrin, (Bereshit 9 amud alef) bearbein uteren gavvnin, beishtetachu devutzina dekardinuta, dehay ihu kalil kol shemahan.

Ushema da, kalil kol shemahan. 151 siman. beillen atvavn kelilan acharanin mitchabberan. venafke illen, veayyle illen. levatar kad itnete veitfashshat butzina dekardinuta, mitztarfe atvavn begavvav, veaale atvavn, venafke atvavn, beraza deillen tesha atvavn. veillen itmesaru lekadishe elyonin,
1018: Lemehach beorcha deraza deatvavn. letzarfa yichuda dishmahan deatvavn, kema dehava yada kahana letzarfa shemahan, beatvavn reshiman.

(Yechezkel 1:8) vide adam mittachat kanfehem. kullehu yede adam, ha okimna, deinnun (nusach acher serafim) ruchin vechevavn veofannim. (keruvim vechayyot veofannim) kullehu begadpin, vidin techot gadpayyhu, lekabbela tzelotin, ulekabbela mare detiuveta. yede adam atrin veduchetin, lekabbela bene nasha, bitzlothon uvautehon, uleaftecha pitchin lekabbela lon, leyachada ulekashshera kishrin, ulemevad reutehon.

Veillen atrin veduchetin deikrun yede adam, dekayyme livni nasha, illen innun shemahan kadishin, deshalitin bechol darga vedarga, (begin) divhon alin bene nasha, bitzlotehon uvautehon, bechol tarin illain. uveda shaltin tattain leella. veraza da, (Tehillim 119:73) yadecha asuni vaychonnuni, veillen shemahan kadishin.

(Shemot 9:22) vayyomer Adonai el moshe nete et yadcha al hashshamayim. vechi hech yachil learama yedeh al shemayya. ella nete: archin. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 18:10) vayyet shamayim vayyerad, meshichu milleella letata. yadcha: atrach. atra dedarga dilach, deat shaari begaveh, veda beraza dishma kadisha. vecholla illae vetatae, beraza dishmahan natle vekayyme. uvehu alin bene nasha lehechalin illain, velet man deyimche bidayyhu. zakkain innun deyadin lesadra yichuda demarehon kedka yeot, ulemehach beorach keshot, begin dela yitun beraza dimhemnuta.

Ta chaze, behechalin illen, it raza illaa go mehemnuta. vechullehu chevavn retichin, kullehu meshanyayn da min da, leitkallela illen beillen letav, leitakkena. vesimanich (Ester 2:9) vayshanneha veet naaroteha letov. beshiva hechalin illen, shelimu deella. kad ishtelim da beda, vealu tzelotin uvautin. deman deyada lesaddera lon, leatkena lon leella. kema deat amer (Ester 2:9) veet sheva hannearot haruyyot latet lah mibbet hammelech.

Hechala kadmaa. (Yeshayahu 45:7) yotzer or uvore choshech. nehiru deeven tava sefiru, deeven tava natzitz litren sitrin, kema (250 amud alef) deokimna limina velismala, or vechoshech. (Tehillim 104:24) ma rabbu maasecha Adonai kullam bechachma asita, kullehu ofannim vegalgallim, mala haaretz kinyanecha vegomer. hammelech hameromam levaddo meaz shema kaddisha yeahadonahi, kelala dishma kaddisha, shelim bitre shemahan, veda hu salik baavira, umitnasse mimot olam.

Hechala tinyayna, el baruch gedol dea, orfaniel, (nusach acher raza atvavn zeirin) dechalil razin deatvavn zeirin dealfa beta. hacha innun dekamre kadosh uvaruch. vehacha ihu kedushsha, uvaruch kevod Adonai. hechala telitaa, lael baruch (46 amud bet) neimot yittenu.

Hechala reviaa hamechaddesh betuvo bechol yom tamid maase vereshit. begin dehacha mitgalgelin nehorin, vedinin dealma. man deihu lechayyim, mitchaddesh kemillekaddemin, leitkayyeyma bealma, binhora dimina, deikre el kidkamran.

Hechala chamishaa. hechala da ikre ahavat olam. veda ihu meshichu dirchimuta dehechala deikre ahava, veda hi ahavat olam ahavtanu Adonai elohenu, baruch atta Adonai habbocher beammo yisrael beahava, beraza deel shadday.

Hechala shetitaa, emet veyatziv venachon vekayyaym. uvaenan dela leafseka ben hechalin illen. (leillen) deha bimshichu ditzlota ureuta mitchabberan kachada, veitkashsheran illen beillen, beraza dishmahan kadishin deshalitin bechol chad vechad.

Hechala sheviaa, adonay sefatay tiftach, raza derazin bilchishu, vela ishtema kala. hacha ihu reuta delibba, leitkavvna ulesalleka reuta mitatta leella, ad en sof, ulekashshera sheviaa bishviaa, (vecholla chad bechad) da beda (nusach acher mittatta leella) ulevatar, meella letatta, leamshacha birchan bechullehu almin, mimmekora dechayye, (nusach acher deihu sheviaa leillaa) deihu hechala sheviaa illaa (veda shechinta) biruta delibba, uvistimu deayynin, deraza deatvavn desheva shemahan illain kadishin.
1019: Hechala sheviaa illaa da, deihu (225 amud alef) mekora dechayye, da ihu birchata kamayyta. veda ihu hechala kadmaa, sheruta decholla meella letatta, ulenatla sheviaa mittatta, leitchabbera da beda, sheviaa bishviaa. deha mehay diltatta, ayel man deayil, lehechala illaa.

Veda hu raza, (Bereshit 45 amud alef) baruch, rivuya dechullehu tattae, kelila bechevavn userafim veofannim, vechullehu hechalin rivuya deraza dekodesh hakkadashim, desharya begaveh bignizu, ucheden ikre baruch, bechol illen rivuyayn uvirchan, verazin deishtelimu ba.

Atta, ittura distimu deatvavn, kelala dechullehu 22 atvavn. veda hu at. Adonai dechalil lon meella, behay Adonai, vechanish lon begavih, veda ihu at Adonai. vechad ihi bishlimu behahu (236 amud bet) nahar deachid ba, salleka leitatra leella, veda ihu raza dichtiv, (Ester 2:13) (225 amud bet) uvaze hannaara baa el hammelech, ucheden et kol asher tomar yinnaten lah. veda ihu raza baruch atta, uvae leitchavvna behay raza, ulekashshera reuta behay raza.
Adonai elohenu: da ihu kishshura veyichuda demalka illaa leella, behay, kad hannaara baa el hammelech et kol asher tomar yinnaten lah.

Velohe avotenu: da raza daavahan, levarcha lah. veda ihu raza, elohe avraham elohe yitzchak velohe yaakov. kema dehay naara la ishtevakat mittattae, hachi name la ishtevakat meavahan lealmin. ihu achidat behon (nusach acher lenatra lon valeateraa la) leatra lah.

Uvegin deitbarcha mikkol chad minnehon, bae leadkera lah al kol chad vechad. ulevatar yitkanneshun kullehu bechibbura chada, (sefer acher lego maar deima) umitattere bahadah, hael haggadol haggibbor vehannora, ha kullehu kachada, lesalleka leella bekadmita meella letatta vehasheta mittatta leella. leachlela lon bahadeh dechevan deamar hael haggadol haggibbor vehannora kullehu kelilan bah. ucheden, el elyon gomel chasadim tovim kone hakkol. veda kelala decholla.

Vezocher chasde avot, deishtahu bahadah (deishtechachan kachada) vealu bimaha, veitbarchun tamman. ulevatar shaari lon veafik lon kad innun itbarchan migavvav. uvehahi hishtachavaa deamar baruch atta Adonai magen avraham, hacha nafke kullehu bichlala, deha bimina kullehu mitbarchan kadka chaze.

Ta chaze, hechala sheviaa da, raza demalka illaa, umitatteran beh avahan kidkamran, veitkelilu beh. vead hasheta itkelilu, uvae leafaka lon, ihu hechala da, vechad afik lon mevarchan, (nusach acher mitbarchan) begin hay naara, keden ihi achidat behu, bechol innun birchan. veaf al gav deha itkelilu hechalin behechalin, hasheta itachidu beinnun birchan kachada, vechad amar melech ozer umoshia umagen, keden afik lon mevarchan.

Vehay, ihu chad hechala sheviaa, beraza dishma kadisha illaa, buchu. 'beracha 'vachesed 'koach 'umishfat, kelala raza (nusach acher deraza) (kolla) veraza da, hu raza (sefer acher deihi) deehye kelala decholla. begin deillen atvavn kelala decholla. begin deillen atvavn, afiku illen (sefer acher lon) denafku minnayyhu, kelala daavahan, veda ihu demitchabbera bahadayyhu, deikre beracha.

Kevan deamar baruch atta Adonai magen avraham, ha achidat birchan minnayyhu, beraza dehechala chamishaa ahava, deihu yemina, veihu chamishaa, leitkashshera birchimu devirchan dimina. vehachi itzterich, meella letata leitbarcha. bekadmita itkelalu hechala behechala kidkamran, vehasheta natle birchan leishtakkecha illen mikkadmat illen. veaf al gav deit denatil (sefer acher daatanetayf) bekadmita. kevan deishtechachu missitra dimina birchan, behechala chamishaa share leachada.

Ulevatar bistar semala, beraza da atta gibbor. vehay ihu chibbura atta vegibbor, teren dinin. vechevan deitmashchan birchan, itkelil berachame, veishtechach behahu sitra kolla kachada, veda hu mechayye metim somech noflim verofe cholim vechulei.

Veda ihu beraza dishma kadisha deikre achadtam, raza ihu beatvavn dishma deikre elohim. begin deillen atvavn sallekin leitattera leella, veafiku lehu illen leitkere behon, vesallekin leitattera leella elohim chayyim, vegara beatvavn, leachada bigriu. umehacha
1020: Itpeshshat letatta, lenatla miggo illen atvavn acharanin, ulesalleka meillen atvavn, lishma deelohim.

Kevan deitmashchan atvavn bechamishaa ureviaa meella kidkamran, shaari veachid birchan meemtzaita dechola, mehechala shetitaa, veachid birchan behay uvehay. uvegin kach (becholla atta kadosh veitkelil) atta kadosh, itkelil atta bekadosh.

Veshimcha kadosh, kevan deamar atta kadosh, amay veshimcha kadosh, hayeynu shem, hayeynu atta. ella ha tanenan, bechol atar deishtechach yichuda vekishshura, baenan (133 amud alef) kedushsha, vetosefet kedushsha, vehahu tosefet ikkara hu yatir mikkolla. uvegin kach, bechullehu ketiv atta, vela yatir, vehacha behay atar, amar kedushsha, vetosefet kedushsha. atta kadosh kedushsha, veshimcha kadosh tosefet kedushsha. ukedoshim bechol yom: ellu shear kedoshin illain, di bechol hechala vehechala, demitkaddeshe mehay tosefet. begin dikdushsha kamayyta ihi lah, vetosefet kedushsha, leitkadsha kol innun shear dekamran.

Ulevatar itkadsha kolla meella, umichullehu avahan, itkeshar bekishshura chada, vehayeynu baruch atta Adonai hael hakkadosh. hacha kolla kishura chada, begin deamar baruch atta Adonai hael hakkadosh. veal da ikre tzerora vekishshura decholla beyichuda chad. zakkaa chulakeh, man deyada lesaddera shevache demareh baatar deitzterich. ad hacha, devekuta uvirkan ukedushsha kachada baavahan.

Mikkan ulehala, kayymin sheeltin uvautin. sheruta devae bar nash lemishal, leminda bemillin demareh, begin lemechoze tiuveteh legabbeh, vela itperash minneh. begin devae bar nash leishtattefa bikdushsha dishma kaddisha illaa, leitattera beh, veihu shema devirkaan vekiddushin, kuzu. raza dishma kaddisha Adonai deihu kaddish bikdushsha. veillen atvavn (acharanin) appiku minneh hane atvavn acharanin, chibbura dehane, kechibbura didchar benukeba. vehane kaddishin illain, raza dikdushsha.

Illen atvavn acharanin ikrun tal. tal hashshamayim. raza dechushebana deatvavn dileh, begin dehacha letatta, kayyman kol millin bechushebana, vela (15 amud bet) chushebana, ella lesihara. uvegin kach bae leitkashshera bikdushsha demareh, vela yitperash bar nash minneh. vechad shail, sheruta disheltin leminda lemareh, leachazaa detiuvete legabbeh. mikkan ulehala, yitperash zeer zeer, vayishal sheeltoy ma deitzterich leshaala.

Vechol sheeltoy yehon, levatar disadder siddura da dekamran. kegavvna da, kol sheeltoy yehon betachanunim uvautin lekamme mareh, vela yatzdik (sefer acher yarchik) garmeh minneh. zakkaa chulakeh, man deyada lesaddera siddura da, lemehach beorach meshar, kadka chaze.
Kegavvna deitachada eshsha bemayya, umaya beeshsha. darom betztzafon, vetzafon bedarom. mizrach bemmaarav, umaarav bemizrach. hachi name itkashar kolla kachada, veyichuda ishtelim da beda.

Vechol innun deyadin lesaddera tzelothon kedka yeot, leitkallela hanni hechalin illen beillen, uleitkashshera da beda. hay bar nash itkashar behu, vekariv leh leitkallela behu. sheelta shail veyahiv leh. zakkaa chulakeh behay alma, uvealma deate.

Batar desiyyem sheeltin vegufa shelim bechol sitrin bechedva delibba veihu shail vesiyyem sheeltin. yehdar leamshacha birchan vechedvavan letatta, beraza dehechala telitaa, leamshacha letatta, veda hu retze Adonai elohenu beammecha yisrael. hay ihu (nusach acher begin) demaamadot innun samchin degufa. sheruta letatta min gufa teren yarchin, ad demate levirkin.

Veillen innun raza demaamadot, dekayyme al karbena. vehacha ihu raza sheruta ditren yarchin milleella, ad birchin, chibbura dinviim. umarot, beraza deatvavn dishma kadisha, deikre (499 403 302) hashetafa. deihu raza dishma deikre tzevaot. da salik, veda nachit. da neviim, veda marot.

Vehacha ihu raza illaa divrayyte dekamran, vechad mate inish lebirkin, yichra baruch atta Adonai hamachazir shechinato letziyyon, veha hacha ahadru berayyte (257 amud bet) lematnitin veitbarchan kachada.
