1021: Tinyayna letatta, deitpekadu beh nishmatin lesalleka, leitchazaa bechezu (258) dechelma. modim, leachrea birchin, leodaa al nishmatin, kidkamran al nishmotenu happekudot, (kevan daashateayl mimmareh) (sefer acher hechala tinyayna leamshacha birchan letatta modim anachnu lecha vehay hechala ihu deitpekadu beh nishmatin lesalleka leitchazaa bechezu dechelma. hacha bae bar nash laakareaa birchin leodaa al nishmatin veda hu al nishmotenu happekudot) ad demate lehattov shimcha ulecha nae lehodot.

Veda hu go raza dishma kaddisha, deikre bam bemuchan. da ikre el elohim, deihu beraza illaa. (Yehoshua 22:22) el elohim Adonai hu yodea. kelala deillen atvavn acharanin denafke minnayyhu, (davar acher vehacha ihu raza chada dechullehu yarchin mevarchin) uletatta, raza dechelma. raza lehahu atar leaala behu nishmatin. uvaenan leamshacha behane birchan, begin leashkecha nayycha behay alma, uvealma deate.

Hechala tattaa letatta, sim shalom tova uveracha. hacha ihu kelala deshalom. shalom leella, shalom letatta, shalom lechol sitrin, shalom befamalya dilella, shalom befamalya diltatta, vehechala da ihu pamalya diltatta. (sefer acher deihu hechala diltatta veda bechibbura vechulei) bechibbura chada befamalya (nusach acher baheykelah) dilella. umehacha nagid lechol innun tattae dilvar.

Vehacha itkelil veishtelim kolla kachada, ella vetatta, binhiru chada, leishtallema shem male, Adonai elohim. shem da deihu shalem, bechol innun hechalin, bechol innun nehorin illain, lemeheve kullehu chad. (sim shalom tova uveracha)

Hay bar nash, kad ishteil mehechala da lenafka levar. yeshavve garmeh, keman denafik mechavruta demalka, umiggo hechaleh, veyamich garmeh kameh. aval yechede garmeh, deha kadmaa ihu, lenatla itra dimshichu devirkaan denagdin miyichuda demareh. da ihu bar, deihu mehechala demalka. deha behay shaata deka nafik mikkamme malka, vecholla kashir bechol hane sitrin, bekishshura (116 amud alef) deyichuda, uvirkan, ukedushsha, vetosefet kedusha. kudesha berich hu kare lefamalya dilella, veamar lon, ketovu lehay bar nash pelanya, meinnun deikrun choshve shemo.

Man choshve shemo. innun dimchashsheve umechavvnin beraza dishmeh, leyachada hechalin behechalin, lekashshera kishrin, uleyachada kullehu beyichuda chada. veillen innun choshve shemo, kema deat amer (Malachi 3:16) ulechoshve shemo. keden achtivu leh, veitreshim veishtemoda leella, (veitreshim) veishtelim ihu leella vetatta.

Uman dekariv kame mareh, vetzalle tzeloteh, vela ashlim yichuda, vela chayish al yekara demareh, lekashshera kishrin kidkamran, tav leh dela ivre. vekudesha berich hu amar (Yirmeyahu 22:30) kitvu et haish hazze ariri gever la yitzlach beyamav. veda ihu (Mishlei 28:24) gozel aviv veimmo.

Hacha ishtelim kolla leella vetatta, raza dishma kaddisha shallita leella. matzfetz matzfetz. (Shemot la) Adonai Adonai el rachum vechannun. hacha ihu raza dishma kaddisha da, leitkaddesha beatvoy beve asara, veatvavn acharanin bikdushsha dichiday bitzlota. batar desiyyem, kaim al ragloy, (nusach acher lechappara) leodaa (120 amud bet) al chovoy, begin dela yehe pitra defuma lesitra achara, leastaa leh, veitkafya kameh. veyekum bekiyyumeh leitbarcha mibbe malka.

Vezakkaa chulakeh man deitkaddash behay gavvna bitzlota kidkamran, vekashar kishrin, veyiched yichudin, veyitkevavn becholla kedka yeot, vela yiste limina velismala. tzeloteh la ahdar berekanayya. kudesha berich hu gazir veihu mevatel. al da ketiv (Mishlei 23:25) yismach avicha veimmecha vetagel yoladtecha. it leh chulaka bealma den, uvealma deate. (1 beerev hi baa hayeynu)

Ketiv (Mishlei 31:15) vattakam beod layla vattitten teref levetah vegomer mehahu ribbuya devirkaan, ukedushsha, vetosefet kedushsha deka natla. kema deat amer (Bereshit 49:27) velaerev yechallek shalal, difligat chulaka lecholla, vaafillu lesitra achara chulaka bilchodaha.

Veraza da, raza livne mehemnuta. chulaka desitra achara misava, kol innun chovin, vechol innun chatain, dehahu bar nash dekashar kishrin deyichuda, deitvadda alayyhu, kullehu sharyayn aleh desitra achara. veinnun chulaka veachasanta desitra achara misava.
1022: Vei la ode aleh, ishtechach mekatrega veyachil leh.

Vei ode al kol chovoy, behahi tzelota, dekashir kishrin deyichuda, veitbarchan illae vetattae. umehahu chulaka desitra achara, kol innun chovin vechattain deode alayyhu, natla lon lechulakeh. veraza da sair. dichtiv, (Vayikra 16:21) vehitvadda alav et kol avonot vegomer, uchetiv venasa hassair vegomer, da hu chulakeh veadveh veachasanteh. vei hahu bar nash tav lesarchane dechovoy, vavy leh, dechullehu natil lon mehahu sitra, beal karcheh dehahu sitra. umiggo denatil lon mehay sitra beal karcheh dehahu sitra, keden avish leh, veithappech aleh mekatrega, vekatrig leh. vechad ode aloy, natil lon hahu sitra achara, veihu adveh vechulakeh.

Veraza da, hachi name karbena, devae leodaa al hahu karbena, kol chovoy vechetoy, lemehav chulaka leman deitzterich. karbena kolla lesitra da chulaka dekudesha, vereuta dekudesha. ulesitra da, hahu chulaka deinnun chovin, vechattain deityeyhivu behodaa al hahu bisra dekarbena. kema dichtiv, (Mishlei 25:21) im raev sonaacha haachilehu lechem vegomer. ki gechalim atta chote vegomer, vesimanich (Ester Adonai:Adonai) yavo hammelech vehaman el hammishte. zakkaa ihu man deyada archeh lemehach beorach keshot.

Vechol man dela yada lesaddera shevacha demareh, tav leh dela ivre. begin deitzterich tzelota deihu shelama leella. (begin deitzterich tzelota) miggo machashava, ureuta delibba, vekala, umilla desifvavn. lemebad shelimu vekishshura veyichuda leella, kegavvna deihu leella. kegavvna denafka shelimu meella letatta, hachi itzterich mittatta leella, lekashshera kishra kadka yeot.

Raza lechavrayyay deyehachun beorach meshar, machashava. vereuta. vekala. umilla. illen arba mekashrin kishrin. levatar keshiru kishrin kullehu kachada, itavidu kullehu reticha chada, leashraa alayyhu shechinta, veitavidu kullehu levatar arbaa samchin leitattera behu, ushechinta istemich alayyhu, bechol innun kishrin illain.

Machashava appik reuta, (reuta appik kolla) reuta denafik miggo machashava, appik kala deishtema, vehahu kala deishtema, salik lekashshera kishrin mittatta leella, hechalin tattain beillain. kala deihu kashir kishrin umashich birchan meella letatta bilchishu, samich illen arbaa samchin: machashava. ureuta. kala. umilla. semichu besiuma dekishshura, atar decholla itkashar beh kachada, veitavidu kullehu chad.

Zakkaa ihu bar nash dekashar kishrin demareh, vesamich semichin kedka yeot, veitkavavn bechol hane millin dekamran. zakkaa ihu behay alma, uvealma deate. ad hacha ishtachlalu hechalin besitra dikdushsha.

Ribbi shimon patach veamar, (Hoshea 6:7) vehema keadam avru verit sham bagdu vi. man yegale afar meenecha adam kadmaa, dekudesha berich hu pakid lach pikkuda chada, vela yachilat lekayyeyma ba. begin deitpattit al millin bishin, deaste lach hahu chivya bisha, dichtiv, (Bereshit 3:1) vehannachash haya arum. uvegin kach, itpattit avatreh, vegarmat mita legarmach, ulechol innun toladin denafku minach. ta chaze, dechol man deitpatta avatreh venachit legabbeh beriga chada, yitavid legabbeh.

Ta chaze, david hava kiuma naitz bimkora demayin navin, vechad itdachya leara achara, vetzarin leh, ulefum tzareh itdachya meara kaddisha. af al gav denachit middargoy ledarga tattaa, kam bekiyyumeh, vela al lesitra achara, veistemar minneh. ma ketiv (Shmuel 1 20:3) veulam chay Adonai veche nafshecha ki kefesa beni uven hammavet. deha nachit bedargoy, ad dehava beh hay shiura. vezakkaa chulakeh, man deistemar mehahu sitra bisha, umikkol dargin dehahu sitra, demishtakkeche bealma.
Dechamma sitrin vedargin it leyetzer hara: nachash akallaton. satan. malach
1023: Hammavet. yetzer hara. veha ukemuha. deaf al gav devishmahan illen ikre, sheva shemahan innun leh: satan. tame. sone. even michshol. arel. ra. tzefoni. illen innun sheva shemahan, lokovel sheva dargin dehechalin dileh, dechullehu missitra misava kidkamran. lokovel illen shiva shemahan, innun deikre behu gehinnam, atar deittedanu beh chayyayvayya dealma. veillen innun: bor. shachat. duma. tit hayyaven. sheol. tzalmavet. eretz tachtit. kol illen shiva madorin degehinnam, lokovel illen sheva shemahan, deit leh leyetzer hara.

Veha okimna, dichmma deit dargin vehechalin listar kedushsha, hachi name listar misava. vechullehu mishtakkeche veshalte bealma, bistar (sefer acher semala) misava. shiva hechalin innun, deinnun lokovel shiva shemahan, deikre behu gehinnam (yetzer hara). vechullehu (leastaa bisha) kayyme ledayyeyna, ulesaava, leinnun chayyayve alma dedabbeke behu, vela istammeran archayyhu minneh, kad innun behay alma.

Deha man deate leitdakkea behay alma, besitra dedachya, medakkein leh, behahu atar deikre raza dimhemnuta. dechamma dargin innun, vechamma memanan, dechullehu kayymin lekarva livne nasha lefulechaneh dekudesha berich hu, uledakkea leh. uman deate leistaava, mesaavin leh behay sitra achara deihu misava. deha kama dargin, vechamma memanan, kullehu kayyme lesaava lon livne nasha.

Man deyikrav behu, veate leitmashshecha batar hahu sitra bisha, aleh ketiv, (Tehillim 89:49) mi gever yichye velo yire mavt yemallet nafsho vegomer. man ihu bar nash deitbere bealma dela yechome mota, hahu dechol alma itmashshechan avatreh. deha behahu zimna deate bar nash lemehav chushebana kame mareh, ad la yippuk mehay alma, chame leh, veha okimna.

Veillen shiva hechalin, deinnun shiva madorin laggehinam. teresar yarchin ikrun, begin deha kema deit listar mehemnuta teresar yarchin, dargin kaddishin, hachi name it lesitra achara da teresar yarchin, dechayyayvayya itdanu behu, venishmeta dilhon ittedanat behu. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, deitmanan raglayyhu minnayyhu behay alma, vela mitkarve letarayyhu, begin leishtezava minnayyhu behahu alma.
Hechala kadmaa. sheruta desitra doyetzer hara. hay hechala kadmaa, ikre bor reka mikkolla. man deate leaala beh, let man deachid beh. kullehu dachyayn leh leminpal dela yekum, let beh semach letav.

Behay hechala, kayyeyma chad memana, veduma shemeh. vehay ihu kayyeyma leella vetatta. da ihu achid benishmeta, kad itdachya mehechala kaddisha, al yeda dehahu memana tahariel, vehay ihu kaim legabbe hahu tara dehahu sitra kaddisha, uvegin kach kayyeyma hay duma, leachada lah lenishmeta, vechamma gardine nimusin bahadeh.

Utechot hay memana, kayyeyma chad memana achara, di elef veribbevan techoteh. vehay memana ikre pittut. da hu deihu kayyeyma lefattaa bene nasha. vehay ihu deshare legabbeh, veaste leh, leistakkela uleayyna bema dela itzterich bechamma zenunin uvechamma niufin. vechol innun deimmeh, kullehu kayyman legabbeh, veazlin kammeh, veachrichan leh leastaa enoy, leistakkela bema dela itzterich.
Vehay ihu sirsura bisha, lechol innun bishin, hay kaim al kivra bezimna deitdan hahu gufa, vetavar leh enoy. begin deihu ravavch lon, kad ihu behay alma, vedileh innun.
Uvehay atar ittedanat nishmeta, ad dealat lehay atar deikre bor, vechamma nechashim veakrabbim it beh, dechullehu aktze lah lehay
1024: Lego min da, it chad rucha achara misava, deihu illaa al kolla. veda kayyeyma al kol hechala da, vechullehu natle begineh, vehay ikre gamgima. hay hu (246 amud alef) sumaka kevavrda, ihu kaim leavasha tadir, deha kad tzelota debar nash itdachya, vela zache bah hahu bar nash, hay rucha kayyeyma, vesalleka veishtattaf berucha misava illaa al kolla, veaste leella, veadkir chovoy devar nash kame kudesha berich hu, vesimanich (Iyov 1:6) vayyavo gam hassatan betocham, vela ketiv vayyavo hassatan ella gam.

Umehay rucha bisha, talyayn kama gardinin acharanin, deinnun memanan leachada milla bisha, o milla tinnufa deappik bar nash mippumeh, ulevatar appik millin kaddishin. vavy lon, vavy lechayyehon, illen innun bene nasha degarme leillen gardinin acharanin leshalletaa, lemifgam atar kaddisha. vavy lon behay alma, vavy lon lealma deate. begin, deillen ruchin misavin, natlin hay milla misava, vechad appik bar nash levatar milla kaddisha, akdimu illen ruche misave, venatle hahi milla misava, umesaave lehahi milla kaddisha, vela zache beh bar nash, vechavyachol tashash chela kaddisha.

Veella 1 meillen it chad memana safsirita shemeh. vechamma gardine nimusin, vehay memana dealayyhu, natle innun millin bishin, vehachi name natle kol illen millin dezarik bar nash bidoy, kad rugeza sharya aloy, deha keden hay memana safsirita nakit hay milla, dezarik bar nash berugezeh, vesalik veamar, da hu karbena diflanya, dekariv lesitra dilan.

Begin dechol sitra denayycha, ihu missitra dimina, umissitra dimhemnuta. vechol sitra derugeza, ihu missitra achara bisha, sitra misava. veal da man deashde min yedoy midi berugeza, kol illen natlin lah lehay milla deizderik, vesalke lah leella, veitkeriv lehahu sitra, veamre da (sefer acher pulechana dekarbena) karbena diflanya.

Vecharoza kare bechol innun rekiin veamre, vavy liflanyya deaste batar el zar, ufalach leel acher. vecharoza kare zimna tinyana veamar, (Hoshea 7:13) oy lahem ki naddu mimmenni vegomer. zakkaa ihu bar nash, deistemar mearchoy, vela yiste limina velismala. vela yinpol bego bera amika, dela yachil lesalleka minneh.

Hechala tinyayna, hechala da, ihu chashuch yattir al hechala kadmaa, hay ikre shachat, lokovel shema deikre tame. begin dehechala kadmaa ikre bor, lokovel shema deikre satan. vehay ikre shachat, lokovel shema deikre tame. behechala da kayymin telat pitchin, litlat sitrin.

Pitcha kadmaa. beh kayyeyma chad memana, astiriyya shemeh. vechamma elef veribbevan memanan techoteh, vehay ihu kayyeyma al kol innun dimchabbele archayyhu, leoshada zara al ara. o demafke zara, dela kearcha. o lechol innun dimzanu bidayyhu. illen innun dela chaman anpe shechinta kelal. ella hay memana devistar misava dekamran, nafik behahu zimna, vechamma innun elef veribbevan, kullehu mitkannefe al hahu bar nash, umesaave leh behay alma. ulevatar kad nafak nishmateh minne mehay alma, hay memana vechol innun deimmeh, mesaavin leh lenishmateh, veachadin bah, (veistaavat behu) veailu lah leittedana behu.

Veillen ikrun shichvat zera rotachat. dechullehu rugezin misavin kayymin kullehu al da, begin dechullehu kayymin vesharan aleh devar nash, behahu zimna deartach garmeh, vechamim leh letiuveta da. ucheden natlin leh lehahu tiuveta. vehahu zara deittoshad beara. veittakafu beh, venatle leh. vesalke leh leella, vegarmu divrit da deyishtabed bistar misava.
1025: Pitcha tinyayna, beh kayyeyma memana achara, taskifa shemeh, vehay ihu memana, al kol innun dimchabbele archayyhu, dela oshde zara al ara, ella deoshde zara bivire, o beisurin chamurin deorayyta, beinnun arayot, hay memana vechamma elef veribbevan deimmeh, kullehu kayyme aleh, (sefer acher lesaava leh valemaydan leh) leittedana leh kema deittemar beinnun acharanin.

Ta chaze, hay memana bideh kasa chada, veikre (Yeshayahu 51:17) kos hattarela kos chamato, vechol innun ketule bet din, deitketalu, o itanashu al chovin illen, kullehu itakaru meillen sitrin misavin, vela it lon chulaka behon, uvehay kassa deikre kos hattarela, begin kassa achara deshatu bekadmita.

Vechol innun dela shatu hahu kassa debet din, leitakkera mehay kos hattarela, levatar kad nafik nishmateh mehay alma, hay memana vechol innun deimmeh, achidan beh veda hu (Amos 8) yom hammar, veravve lah lehay nishmeta, mikkamma dinin meshanyayn illen meillen.

Behechala da, kayyeyma chad rucha, deillen memanan techoteh, veda hu niatziriel. mehay rucha takkifa, nafke telat tippin, meriran, denafle behay (246 amud bet) kos hattarela. chad ikre chatzatz. vechad, ikre mar hamavet vechad ikre kubbaat, (davar acher vechullehu mitkanshe lehay kos levatar) veillen telat tippin naflu levatar mehay kos, (nafku taletateypeyn) (sefer acher behahi) dehahi charba dekatla bene nasha, kema deukemuha.

Pitcha telitaa, beh kayyeyma memana chad sangaddiel shemeh, vehay ihu memana, al kol innun deayyle hay berit kaddisha, beintu achara, deihu mehahu sitra deel nechar. vechol innun dimchabbele archayyhu beda, umeshakre beat kayyayma kaddisha, hay memana, vechol innun memanan deimmeh, kullehu metzayyeyre begavavyyhu, tziyyurin deinnun nashin misavin, deisteav behu hahu kayyeyma kaddisha, vechullehu itreshimu kammeh, kad nafik bar nash mehay alma, umesaave leh levatar lehahu rucha.

Vehechala da, talyayn kol raze decharashin, lekatla bene nasha ad la yimte zimnayyhu, vechullehu charshin deitzterichu bene nasha. innun decharshe charshayyhu leistaava behu, kegon dehava bilam, charash becharshoy, veisteav bekadmita bimsaavu dezara rotachat deashde bivire, uvegin da, beh ittedan, behahu shichvat zera rotachat dekamran. veal da, hay hechala ikre, shachat tame.

Uvehay hechala, it rucha achara, di memana techot hahu rucha dilella, vehay ikre sartaya, vechamma elef veribbevan techoteh. (130 amud alef) vechullehu kayyme al hahi milla, denafik bahade rucha debar nash bechelma, miggo sitra kaddisha. hay rucha misava, vechol innun gardinin deimmeh, kullehu nafke umitchabberan behahi milla, venachte bah, umitarve bahadah, begin leachchasha lah minneh, veodin leh lebar nash millin acharanin, milin kedivin, bemilla dikshot.

Dechacha archoy dichdiva, deilmale la natil milla dikshot, la yachil letakkena kedivoy. uf hacha illen, kevan demitare bemille keshot, umachchishe lon minneh, modae leh milla dikshot, begin lekayyeyma kedivoy. levatar (mitpashshete kol inun) (sefer acher mitpashta hahi milla, beinnun) tattae letatta, delet lon kiuma. vela mitkayyeyme, veode milin bealma, lechamma sitrin (davar acher vechol hane inun letatta bedargin dametaperashean levar bechamma sitrin) lechamma zayynin.

Mehechala da, nafkin teren ruchin, demithappechan, lezimnin guverin, lezimnin nashin, veillen azlin veshatan bealma baavira, vechayychan bivne nasha bego chelma, veitchazun lon leguverin, kenashin shefiran bechezu dechelma, venatle tiuveta devar nash. uf hachi lenashin, itchazun keguverin, veillen ikrun raa venga, kema deat amer (Tehillim 91:10) lo teunne elecha raa venega lo yikrav beoholecha.

Veillen ikrun ruche tattae letatta. denafke miggo shalhova deeshsha. dechad natlin illen ruchin dilella, di bego hechala da, nafku tere shalhove deeshsha, veillen tasan bealma, veitavidu illen teren ruchin kadka amaran, vecholla besitra da misava. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay deitmanan missitrin illen veistemaru minnayyhu. veal
1026: Da ketiv, (Mishlei 7:Adonai) lishmarcha meishsha zara vegomer.

Hechala telitaa. hechala da, ihu hechala deafil vechashich, velet beh nehora kelal, veihu afil yattir min kadmae. vehay ihu deikre duma, lokovel shema deikre sone. behechala da kayyme arba pitchin, chad kayyeyma lesitra da, vechad lesitra da, vechen learba sitrin.

Chad memana kayyeyma al hay pitcha kadmaa, vehay memana kayyeyma behahu takifu derugeza dealma. kad dina sharya bealma, hay memana deshare behay pitcha, natil zayynin, veanach lon leinnun tarin deve kenishta (divne nasha), vehay ikre sakafortayya veda hu kishlona dealma, veal da ketiv (Mishlei 4:19) derech reshaim kaafela lo yadu bamme yikkashelu, (hay memana kayyeyma al parashat archin lemechome) behahu zimna deihu shallit, vesharya dina bealma, ihu kayyeyma lemechome beman deazil yechiday beshuka, vei hu ira bahadeh, yachil lenazka leh, uleatra mazzaleh.

Pitcha tinyayna, beh kayyeyma chad memana acharina, veda ihu kayyeyma lenatla pitkin dedina, veda ihu sangadiel. utechot yedeh, kama gardine nimusin, deshaltan, dekayymin lekabbela innun pitkin dedina, vehay kayyeyma al pitcha da.

Vechad natil pitka dedina, hay kayyeyma al pitcha da, venachit letatta, leinnun pitchin chashochan diltatta. chad lehahu deikre shachat. vechad lehahu deikre bor, deinnun letatta. vetamman, kama elef, vechamma ribbevan, memanan deshalte bealma lemebad dina, veishtelim dina behahu pitka.

Pitcha telitaa. behay pitcha, it memana achara, angerayon shemeh veda ihu kayyeyma, al kol innun marin umachovin, vechilchulin veeshsha degarme. deha minneh nafke kama vechamma elef veribbevan dimmanan immeh, al kol innun marin umachovin kema deittemar.

Pitcha reviaa, hacha ihu chad rucha, deitbere (266 amud bet) bifgimu desihara, veikre askara. vehay kayyeyma al ketule deravye, veda itchaze lon, vechayich behon, ad dekatil lon, veidme lon keitteta immeh deravye, umenika lon, vechayycha behu, vaachidat lon, vekatlat lon.

Beemtzaita dehay hechala, kayyeyma chad rucha, deikre agirison. hay itmana, al kol innun demetin mibbar telesar shenin, ad esrin shenin. hay ihu kettola dilhon, kema deokimna, veda ihu bechavruta (davar acher bechachmeta) dehahu nachash (248 amud bet) kidkamran vekayyeyma bahadeh, veazil avatreh. veal da ikre malach hammavet tov meod, dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:31) vehinne tov meod, veokimna.

Mehacha mitpashshetin venafkin teren ruchin, af vechema. veillen itmenun, al kol innun deshame nezifa mimman delae beorayyta, veitrachtzan beh, vela chayyshe aleh. vechen al kol innun dechayychan mimmille deorayyta, o mimmille derabbanan.

Meaf vechemma illen, nafkin kama elef, vechamma rivvan, vechullehu nafke vesharan alayyhu divne nasha, innun demishtaddelin beorayyta, o demishtaddele bemille demitzva, veazle bearcha demitzva. begin deyitatztzevun, vela yechodun bah. umitteren illen dachil moshe, kad chavu yisrael, venachit min tura dichtiv, (Devarim 9:19) ki yagorti mippene haaf vehachema.

Techot illen, it rucha chada, dekayyeyma al kol innun mare delishana bisha, dechad mitare bene nasha belishana bisha, o hahu bar nash deitari belishana bisha, keden itar hay rucha bisha misava dilella, deikre sachsicha. veihu shaari al hahu itaruta delishana bisha, deshaari beh bene nasha, veihu al leella, vegarim behahu itaru delishana bisha, mota vecharba vekatola bealma.
1027: Vavy leinnun demitare lehay sitra bisha, vela natre pumayyhu velishanehon, vela chashshe al da, vela yade deha beitaru diltatta, talya itaru dilella, ben letav ben levish.

Ta chaze, kad hay itaru delishana bisha itar letata, keden hay nachash akallaton, salik kaskesoy, veokim lon bisliku, veitar merisha ad ragloy. vechad kaskesoy seliku umitare, keden kol gufa itar. kaskesoy, illen innun kol gardine nimusin dilvar.

Vechullehu mitare veachadin behahu milla bisha, umitare legave hahu (Yeshayahu 27:1) nachash bariach, keden kol gufa bisha, itar meresheh vead ragloy, bechol hane hechalin dekamran. vechol innun kaskesin behahu gilda, nachtin letatta, vehahu gilda itpeshshat minneh venachit letatta. vegufa salik, veitar lemehevi dalttora leella.

Ta chaze, af al gav dezimna kevia ihu, lechol chivyayn dealma, leitpashsheta mishcha dilhon, la mitpashshete, ella bezimna demitare belishana bisha letatta, ucheden itar hahu rucha (nusach acher chivya) bisha leella, ufashat mashkeh vekaskesoy minneh. da salik, veda nachit, vekashya aleh hahu itpashshetuta dekaskesoy bemishkeh mikkolla. may taama. begin deitperash miziuugeh. deilmale hava kolla bechibbura chada, la yachlin almin lemisbal lon, vecholla begin itaruta delishana bisha diltatta.

Vechad chivyayn diltatta mitpashshete mehahu mishcha, keden kol chad vechad yahiv kala, veatar lechamma chivyayn dekayyme behahu atar, deikre bor, detamman kama nechashin kayymin. vechullehu daltorin, leatara lehay chivya rabba, lemeheve dalttora al alma. vecholla begin hay itaru delishana bisha, kad kayyeyma itaruta dileh letatta.

Kegavvna da, man delae beorayyta, kama innun deikrun leshon hakkodesh, demitchabberan veatare ataruta, lehahu atar deikre lashon hakkodesh. lashon mehahu kodesh dilella. vechamma kedushot vekiddushin mitarin michol sitrin. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, innun degarme leatara kiddushin leella uletatta, kedusha dilella ukedushsha diltatta.

Veal da ketiv, (Vayikra 11:44) vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim. vehitkaddishtem: ellu mayim rishonim. veinnun itkerun mayin illain. vihyitem kedoshim: illen mayin tattain, veikrun mayim acharonim. umazon beemtza, ben mayim rishonim lemayim acharonim. veal da mazon, lav ihu bemayim acharonim, ella bemayim rishonim. mayim rishonim meella dimzona talya beh. vela bemayim acharonim. veraza lekaddishe elyonin ityeyhiv. zakkaa chulakehon bealma den, uvealma deate.

Hechala reviaa. hechala da, ihu deikre (7 amud alef) chova. veda ihu (Tehillim 40:3) tit hayyvin, lokovel shema achara deikre even michshol, vecholla chad. ihu chova, begin detamman kayyme kol chove dealma, achrauta dechovin.

Begin dechad chavan beni nasha, kol innun gardine nimusin, natlin innun chovin, umanche lon behay hechala deikre chova. vechol zachyayn dealma, kullehu malachin kadishin dimmanan al zachvavn dealma, kullehu natle leinnun zachvavn, veokme lon behechala reviaa deikre zechut, vetamman kayyme zachvavn divni nasha. vechovin kayyme behechala achara, deikre chova. veatkalu kachada beyoma derosh hashshana ki (Kohelet 7:14) gam et ze leummat ze asa haelohim. ulevatar deachrau zachyayn, o chovin, lesitra da, o lesitra da, hachi natzach.

Veal da, beyoma derosh hashshana, kad mitarin illen teren sitrin, zechut vechova. uvehu talyayn chayyim umavet. i zachyayn achrau, lesitra da deikre zechut, ichtuv bar nash behahu sitra deikre chayyim.
1028: Begin, dehane teren sitrin kayyme behahu yoma, da besitra da, veda besitra da. i zache hahu bar nash, venatzchin innun zachyayn, ha ichtuv hahu bar nash lechayim. begin deachid beh hay sitra kadisha, deikre zechut, vechayyim achid beh, veamar da dili hu, vedidi hava, ucheden ichtuv hahu bar nash lechayim. (sefer acher veechtov ad ihu dileh)

Vei natzchan chovin, hay sitra achara misava, deikre chova umavt, achid beh, amar hay didi hu, vedidi havi, ucheden ichtuv deihu dileh. veda hu detanenan, deha beyoma da derosh hashshana, ichtuv bar nash, o lechayim o lemita. i ichtuv besitra dikdusha, ichtuv lechayim, veitkayyaym tamman, veitdevak beh. vei ichtuv besitra achara, itkeyyaym besitra dimsaavuta, vedavik beh, veda hu hen lechayim hen lamavt. veitmeshach behay sitra o behay sitra.

Kol zimna deihu kayyeyma besitra da dikdusha, kol kiddushin vechol dachyayn mitdabbekin beh. yikra vekudesha berich hu yativ veyyishma leh, aleh ketiv (Tehillim 91:15-16) yikraeni veeenehu immo anochi vetzara achalletzehu vaachabbedehu orech yamim asbiehu vearehu bishuati. vechol zimna deihu kayyeyma besitra achara dimsaava, kol misavu, vechol chova, vechol bishin mitdabbekan beh. yikra, velet man deyishma leh. merachaka ihu mekudesha berich hu, aleh ketiv (Tehillim 119:155) rachok mershaim yeshua uchetiv (Yeshayahu 1:15) gam ki tarbu tefilla enenni shomea.

Hechala da, ihu atar dechol innun deikrun elohim acherim, begin deitgalleyayn hacha. vechol innun dimfattu lehu livne nasha beinnugin dehay alma, leaznaa leitannega beinnuge niufin dealma, umashche lehu batar innugin veniufin dehay alma, kidkamran.

Behay hechala, itchaze chad rucha shallit takkifa, deihu al kullehu, veda ikre uf hachi el, kegavvna deachara (258 amud alef) devistar kedushsha. hay ihu (Devarim lak) el nechar. veda ihu dimfatte levar nash delae beorayyta, o dekaim beve midrasha. hay rucha takkifa mefatte leh, vechashiv kama hirhurin, veamar ma at kaim hacha, tav lach lemehach bechabburat innun degau al bene nasha, veinnun deazlin batar nashin shefiran, umitannege beinnuge alma. kevan debar nash itpatte avatreh, keden kullehu shatyayn veazle veitmashshechaan avatreh.

Vechamma innun acharanin dekayymin techoteh, vechullehu mesaave leh behay alma, umesaave leh behahu alma. (150 amud bet) veinnun ikrun tzoa rotachat dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 30:22) tze tomar lo. innun dargin dekayymin lesaava tadir, veha ittemar.

Beemtzaita dehay hechala, it rucha achara, deikre nega. umehay nafka rucha achara deikre nega tzaraat. veihu kayyeyma tadir, lesaava lechol innun marehon delishana bisha, yatir al kol ma dimsaavin leh. vehay nega illaa, ihu memana al kol innun patore deshabbeta, dechad ayel shabbeta, vela itsedaru beinnuga deshabbeta kedka yeot, veinnun ka mevazze innuga deshabbeta, hay nega natil leinnun patore delav innun beinnuga deshabbeta (252 amud bet) kidkamran.

Vechad hay natil leinnun patore, kol innun gardine nimusin dekayyme beh, kullehu patche veamre, (Tehillim 109:17-18) vayeehav kelala vattevoehu velo chafetz bivracha vattirchak mimmennu. veyyilbash kelala kemaddo vegomer. yenakkesh noshe lechol asher lo vegomer. al yehi lo moshech chased vegomer.

Veha okimna, behahu lelya deshabbeta, kad patore ityeyhivu lehahu sitra bisha, keden ittakkaf hahu sitra bisha, misava, vehahu bar nash itmesar lehahu sitra. vavy leh deitgera mehahu sitra kadisha, sitra dimhemnuta. veitpekkad besitra achara misava. kegavvna da bechol innun seudate deyom tov.
1029: Bene chayye umezone behippucha ihu. uvehahu hechala achara kadisha, la kayyme telat illen, vetalyayn leella, (ayyen 6 amud alef) vehacha kayymin levish. dechad (sefer acher matu benoy davar nash) mate bar nash lehay hechala, ha tamman kayymin chevavn leshetzaa lon. veha tamman benin kad innun zeirin, mehacha nafka, begin leitmanaa kategora alayyhu. veha tamman kayymin mezone, leabera lon minnih. vecholla talya bechova. veal da ikre hay hechala chova. kema deittemar.

Umehacha nafka chad rucha misava, deikre aririya. vechamma elef verivvan immeh, vechullehu ikrun orre yom, kema deat amer (Iyov 3:8) yikkevuhu orre yom. vehay rucha vechol innun deimmeh, kullehu kayyme lenatla hahi milla delayit bar nash garmeh berugezeh, veillen mitare lehay chivya, deikre (Yeshayahu 27:1) livyatan nachash akalaton, begin leayytaa uleatara levavtin al alma, hada hu dichtiv yikkevuhu orre yom vegomer.

Veillen orre yom, shaltin al rige veshate deyoma, venatle innun milin delayit bar nash garmeh, ben berugeza, ben beomaa, uvehahi milla, mitare lehay nachash akallaton, deikre livyatan, begin lekayyeyma leh lechabbela lealma. veal da layit iyyov yomeh betzaareh, vela gufeh. dichtiv (Iyov 3:1) vaykallel et yomo batchilla, ulevatar yikkevuhu orre yom. rachamana lishezvan missitra bisha, umitukefoy. umikkol milla bisha.

Hechala chamishaa. hechala da, ihu hechala deikre (metzora 54 amud alef) sheol, lokovel hahu shema deikre arel, veha okimna deda ihu raza dearla. behay hechala, it chad pitcha, vechad memana aleh. veda ihu memana leatara tadir kitruga al alma, vehay rucha ikre eva, begin dishma dehay pitcha eva shemeh, vesimanich (Bereshit 3:15) veeva ashit bencha uven haishsha vegomer.

Behay hechala kayyeyma chad rucha deshallit al kolla, vehay ikre shoded. veihu (shaved) (Yeshayahu 59:7) shod vashever. veda hu shoded beture rammae, go tinarin veturin. mehechala da yanke kol innun meshadde umeshatze becharbenin. umehacha nafkin, kol innun dekatle besayyfin verumechin, veazlin batar lahat hacherev hammithappechet leshetzaa kolla.

Mehay nafik rucha achara, veikre shod. vechad shallit kafna al alma, hay rucha deikre shod, ihu ishtechach. verucha achara ishtattaf immeh, deikre kafan. veillen azle bealma, umishtachche lokovel bene nasha, vehayeynu dichtiv, (Iyov Adonai:22) leshod ulechafan tischak. veillen avdin kitruga livne nasha, umeshadde lecholla. chad deikre shod, devatar deazil bego turin ramain, veshadid vechariv veshetze kolla. keden tav veshadad livne nasha, umetin bechulesha dileh. vechad achle bene nasha, la savin, begin deihu shalta bealma.

Uvehahu zimna, man deavid chesed im bene nasha, veyahiv lon lemechal ulemishte, keday ihu ledachyay lon leillen teren ruchin levar, dela shalte bealma. vechad yisrael la avde chesed im bene nasha, ushear ammin avde chesed bealma. keden illen teren ruchin mitvassemin (sefer acher lishar ammin vametakepay vechulei) millayyhu, umitkefe alayyhu deyisrael. begin deha keden itkaf hahu sitra achara, veyisrael itchappeyayn.

Vechad yisrael avde chesed, itkafya hahu sitra achara veitchallash, vesitra dikdushsha itkaf. vechad yisrael la mitare bechesed, innun terin ruchin (davar acher matebasemay, chad itbesam lehu lishar ammin) umithappeche leachpeyay lon leyisrael, ucheden innun birchaan denachte milleella, missetar yemina, yanke lon shear ammin. (davar acher vekayyeyma lehahu sitra) vehada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 1:6) samuni notera et hakkeramim, illen shear ammin. karmi shelli lo natarti, illen yisrael. begin dishar ammin mashche leh begavavyyhu, beinnun chasadim deavdin im bene nasha. veyisrael merachakan leh migavavyyhu, begin dela mishtaddele beinnun chasadim kishar ammin.
Utechot illen ruchin, kayymin kol innun deikrun arla. zemore
1030: Arla, anfe arla. veella minnehon chad memana, deikre gezar dinayya. vehay ihu kayyeyma al kol innun dela natre shene arla deilana. veal kol innun, dimakkeve et kayyayma livrayyhu. veal da, baa chivya lekatla livreh demoshe. ad degazrat leh tzifora, dichtiv, (Shemot 4:25) vattikkach tzifora tzor vattichrot et arlat benah vegomer.

Vehay rucha, memana al beni nasha dimchabbele archayyhu, vela chayyshe likara demarihon, lemetar at kayyayma kadisha. vehay ail lon lagehinnam, lehahu atar deikre sheol vaavadon, veitdan tamman, kema deokimna hacha.

Behay hechala lego beemtzaita, kayyeyma chad rucha, deihu kayyeyma vechamin al orchin ushevilin, lemechome lechol innun deavrin al pitgame orayyta. kede lemeal devavu, ben tatta leella. begin dechol hay hechala eva ihu.

Hay vechol innun acharanin, kullehu kayymin leachazaa anpin nehirin livne nasha, ulemifte lehu, begin deyistun meorach keshot, uleamshacha lon avatrayyhu, ulevatar innun katle lon, vimutun bitren almin. dichtiv, (Mishlei Adonai:4) veacharitah mara challaana chadda kecherev piyyot.

Hay rucha, ihu ikre afrira. afra dekitma. dela avid toladin veevin lealmin, begin dehay ihu afra dekitma. veaf al gav deikre afar, lav ihu afra kadisha, deavid evin, veikre (Iyov 28) afrot zahav. ella kema deat amer, (Bamidbar 19:17) meafar serefat hachattat. veda hu afar serefat hachattat, vesimana da atya bitren sitrin. chad, begin deihu kalil behay chattat, raza dehahu chivya takkifa. vechad, dechad bar nash avid chattat, ihu atkif lehay afar, veshalta bealma.

Vehay ihu kalil (Bamidbar Adonai:18) beme hammarim hameararim, veal da, itzterich leintu deastiat techot balah, veavdat ovada deeshet zenunim, leashkaa lah mayya kelilan beafra, deihu mikkarka hammishkan. vehay afar ihu mehahu atar deikre karka vehahu ikre karka dehahu mishkan. vehay afar mehahu karka ihu. uvegin kach, itzterich kahana leashkaa lehay itteta, kegavvna da. vecholla ihu birmiza illaa.

Zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, dekudesha berich hu madke lon bemayin dachyayn illain dichtiv (Yechezkel 36:25) vezarakti alechem mayim tehorim utehartem. mayim tehorim ha amaran, ben mayim rishonim lemayim acharonim. veaf al gav deha okimna, mayim rishonim mitzva, hachi itkerun. umayim acharonim chova hachi name itkerun, veha okimna al teren sitrin illen, da sitra dikdushsha itkere mitzva. veda sitra achara, itkere chova. uvegin kach chulakeh natal behahu mayya, veal da ketiv, vezarakti alechem mayim tehorim utehartem.

Hechala shetitaa. hechala da, kayyeyma illaa, al kol innun shear hechalin tattain. arba pitchin, it lehechala da. chad, ikre mavet. vechad, ikre ra. vechad, ikre tzalmavet. vechad, ikre ofel. illen arba pitchin, kayymin tadir leavasha. illen innun kelala decholla.

Kema deit besitra dikdushsha, beraza dimhemnuta, arba pitchin learba sitrin, demitkashsheran da beda, vechullehu kadishin. hachi name letatta, hacha. vechad illen mitkashsheran umitchabberan da im da kachada, behechala da, keden ikre bet chaver. kema deat amer, (Mishlei 21:9) meeshshet midyanim uvet chaver. vehay hechala, kayyeyma leavasha tadir.

Al hay hechala ketiv, (Mishlei 27:6) venatarot neshikot sone, begin dehacha kayyman, kol innun neshikin bishin, vetiuvetin bishin, vechol iddunin degufa dehay alma, di beinnun iddunin ittarach bar nash mehay alma, umealma deate. veal hay hechala ketiv, (Mishlei Adonai:3) ki nofet
1031: Behay hechala, kayyeyma chad rucha, deihu memana al kol illen diltatta, veihu kelala al kol shear ruchin. hay hechala, mitkashsheta bekishutoy dishfiru, al kol innun hechalin. behechala da, mitlakkede raglayyhu detippeshae. al hay hechala ketiv, (Mishlei 6:25) al tachmod yafyah bilvavecha veal tikkachacha beafappeha.

Behay hechala, talyayn kol tiuvetin dealma. vechol innun innugin detippeshae, chasre libba, chasre data. kema deat amer (Mishlei 7:7-8) vaere bappetayim avina vabbanim naar. chasar lev. over bashshuk etzel pina vegomer. beneshef beerev yom vegomer. ucheden itkerivu ragloy lehay hechala, deihu kelala dechullehu tattain. keden, (Mishlei 7:10) vehinne ishsha likrato shit zona unetzurat lev. shit, da ihu hay hechala, deihu shetitae lechol shear hechalin. vehacha kayyeyma zona, leaftea letippeshain.

Behay hechala kayyeyma vela kayyeyma. nachta umefatta, salleka veastiat. kema deat amer (Mishlei 7:11-12) bevetah lo yishkenu ragleha. paam bachutz paam barchovot, kad salleka leella. (Mishlei 7:11-12) veetzel kol pinna teerov. kad natil nishmeta.

Ma ketiv, (Mishlei 7:13) vehechozika bo venashka lo. illen innun neshikin, lesaava, uleataa bene nasha avatrah. begin dehacha, ihu atar dechol innun neshikin bishin, umikkol zenunim nucherain, deinnun metikin lefum shaata. vavy lesofayyhu, kema dichtiv (Mishlei Adonai:3) vechalak mishshemen chikkah.

Uchetiv veacharitah mara challaana. may mara challaana. ella, kad bar nash itpatta avatrah behay alma, umata zimneh leistalleka mehay alma, ihi kayyeyma aleh debar nash, veitgelimat kammeh biglima degufa deeshsha vecharba shinana beyadah, utelat tippin ba.

Veukemuha, uva tippa chada, meinnun tippin deihi merira, uveshaata deatil lah lefumeh debar nash, al bemeoy. ucheden nishmeta itbalbela, vehahi tippa shatya veazlat bego gufa, veakarat lah lenishmeta meatra, vela shavik lah lenishmeta atar lemetav, veihi mara challaana, veatim lah bar nash bimriru, chalaf hahu metika, detaamu bah behay alma, kad itmeshachu batrah, levatar ashde tippa achara, venishmeta nafkat, umit bar nash. ulevatar ashde tippa achara, virokin anpoy, veavish. begin denishmeta hi kadisha, vechad shalta alah da sitra achara misava, akrat mikkammeh, vela ityashva kachada.

Begin kach, kema deitdevak beinnun neshikin bishin behay alma, uf hachi name behay shaata. dei bar nash itmeshach avatrah behay alma, veshavak sitra kadisha, keden nishmeta la ahadrat lehahu atar kadisha. uchemma deitmeshach avatrah behay alma, hachi name shalta al nishmateh, ucheden nishmateh nafkat befitture, veukemuha. vechol da, begin innun neshikin denashsheka leh behay alma, deinnun metikin. ulevatar, meriran leh behay shaata. veal da, vehechozika bo venashka lo, behay alma, kema deokimna.

(Mishlei 7:13) heeza faneha vattomar lo, begin divhay hechala kayymin kol kategorin, vechol shelichan bishin demishtachche legabbe devar nash, veavde leh ditakken betikkunoy, visalsel besareh, veyitseche, veyittakan begin deyistakkelun beh. hacha kayyeyma rucha chada, deikre sekatufa. veda hu memana al kol tikkuna vesilsula divne nasha.

Lego dehay hechala, kayyeyma chad memana achara, dehay memana achara, ihu atar leh lebar nash levatar, leatara lon, deha ihu metakken garmeh, umesalsel besareh, deyittol bideh chad mara leistakkela beh, veshavve leh bideh, veistakkal beh, vechame diyyukeneh behahu chezu. uvehay atar lehahu rucha chela achara. deikre asirta, umehacha (190 amud bet 264 amud alef, Vayikra 25 amud alef, 234 amud bet) nafke, kol innun deachziu kedivin livne nasha bechelmayyhu. vechol innun deachzeyayn millin vela mitkayyeyme behu, ella learbeva lon.
1032: Ulevatar, kad innun bene nasha itmashshechan behahu chezu, deikre mara. keden kullehu begasuta derucha dilhon, vehay rucha deikre asirta, ihu atar lechad rucha memana deihu techot yedeh, veal benukeba diltatta dechol nukevin, vesalik mittamman chad rucha achara, deihu memana im hahu rucha deikre askara kidkamran. veda ihu lilit imma deshedin. vechad hahu bar nash atar lehay rucha achara deikre asirta, keden itchabbar immeh dehahu bar nash, veitkeshar immeh tadir. ucheden bechol resh yarcha veyarcha, itar hahu rucha, dechezu bisha bahadah delilit, ulezimnin deitzak minnayyhu hahu bar nash, vayyippol leara, vela yachil lemekam, o yamut. vechol da garim, hahu chezu demara, deihu mistakkel beh. deha kema deachze gasuta derucha belibbeh, hachi name asge rucha bisha legabbeh. veal da kolla kayyeyma behahu itaru diltatta.

(Mishlei 7:14) zivche shelamim alay. ta chaze, shelamim la atyayn al chova, vela al chattat, ella al shalom. may shelamim. ella shelamim mitteren sitrin, dela ishtechach mekatrega aleh, la leella, vela letatta. man ihu mekatrega. ella hahu sitra dismala deyetzer hara, deyishtechach bishlama dimina. veal da, zivche shelamim alay. (davar acher alay dayyka, hahu zivche shelamim alay ihu begin dela ishtechach mekatrega al alma)

Davar acher zivche shelamim alay. ha ana beshalva legabbach, leachazaa lach shalom. uvegin kach, hayyom shillamti nedaray, leaftea bene alma tadir. al ken yatzati likratecha vegomer, deyadana deant chaser libba, chaser tova. leshacher panecha, leitchabbera bahadach bechol bishin dealma. veyeot lach leahanaa, ulemite batar tiuvetin dehay alma. vedache leh mimmilla lemilla, umibbish levish. ahadarna beinnun tippeshain, veshachirna panycha, vaemtzaekka, kevar ashkachna lach leitdabbeka vach.

Lecha nirve dodim ad habboker, hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 24:15) veen noef shamra neshef. deha keden ihu zimna leshalletaa. lecha nirve dodim, nehach kachada, ha ana immach, deha ad kean at ravya annet bechelach, i hasheta la titannag garmach, ematay, kad tehe siv, hasheta hu zimna. may tama. ki en haish beveto, da yetzer tov, dela sharya hacha begavvavch, velav ihu zimna, halach bederech merachok, dela sharya bebar nash, ella bederech merachok, kad ihu mittelesar shenin ulehala. velav bechol bar nash, vaana kaim immach miyyoma deityelidat, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 4:7) lappetach chattat rovetz. vehasheta deant ravvavk, hasheta zimna lach leitannega garmach.

(Mishlei 7:20) tzeror hakkesef lakach beyado, lesalleka leella, uleitakkeva tamman (sefer acher uleitanaga). leyom hakkese yavo veto, emat yavo lokovleh, leyom hakkese deihu yoma dedina, leashgacha bedina, dichtiv (Tehillim 81:4) bakkese leyom chaggenu. bezimna deitzterich bar nash leitannega bealma, uleithani beh, itrachaka minneh. uvezimna desharya dina bealma, keden ate legabbeh lemevad ammeh dina, veal da hittattu berov likchah vegomer. ad yefallach chetz kevedo. zakkain innun tzadikayyay, deyadin archin kadishin, lemehach behu, vela yistun limina velismala, zakkain innun bealma den, uvealma deate.

Hechala sheviaa. hada hu hechala dishmare dechamra, leitravvava beh. kema deat amer (Bereshit 9:21) vayyesht min hayyayin vayyishchar vayyitgal. sechita dechol innun anavin, kullehu anavin bishin, hacha ihu sechita dilhon. veda ihu (tehillim 75) yayin chamar. shemarim dechamar delet man deshate minneh, dela garim mota legarmeh. miyena da, atimat chavva levalah, vealat leh behechala da, detanenan, sachata anavin, veyahivat leh, vegarimat mota leh, ulechol alma avatreh.

Behechala da, kayymin kol innun nishmatin misavin, denachte lechol innun di besitra da mitdabbeke, vehahu rucha denachta lechol innun di missitraha, mehacha nafke. kegavvna deinnun satu archayyhu behay alma, veishtedalu biznuta, baatar dela itzterich, leitrachaka meorach keshot. keden, kema deihu itdebak
1033: Behahu sitra deyetzer hara biznuta, hachi name nafik mehechala da rucha misava, lesaava leh, velivra denafik mittamman.

Vehahu bera ikre mamzer, deate missitra deel zar. kema deihu ishtechach behahu tiuveta, uvehahu zenuta behahu sitra deyetzer hara, hachi name mashich legabbeh dehahu bera rucha achara misava, desaiv, vecholla sahadin aleh deihu mamzer, vehachi kol ovadoy vesitroy behahu gavvna mammash.

Mehechala da nafik chad rucha, di memana al innun ruchin deikre tzefoni. vesimanich, (Mishlei 27:16) tzofneha tzafan ruach. vehay ihu memana al da. vehay hechala sheviaa, lokovel hahu shema deikre (Yechezkel 31:14) eretz tachtit. veal da ketiv, (Yoel 2:20) veet hatztzefoni archik mealechem.

Hacha ihu nekuda chada, dekayyeyma lego bego, umehacha nafke kol innun ruchin acharanin deshatan bealma, veshaltin behay alma, bechol innun millin veovadin, deitmesaru besitra dismala. umehacha nafke kol innun zikin netzitzin, demitdaache lealtar, lahate umitdaache. umeillen nafkin ruchin acharanin, deshatyayn bealma, umishtattefe leinnun denafku miggo tehoma rabba. veihu hay hechala, kema deat amer (Tehillim 36:7) mishpatecha tehom rabba. veinnun ruchin dela itmesaru lemiglam bealmin, veitchazun vela itchazun itchazun kema deittemar.

Ulevatar innun ruchin deshatyayn bealma, veillen kayyme lemerchash nissin livne nasha. begin deillen la kayymin betinnufa dimsaava kol kach keacharanin. vechad rucha memana alayyhu, veikre nesira, deihu itnesar meinnun sitrin dimsaavu yatir, (Vayikra 25 amud alef) veillen parche baavera, veavishu lesitra dilhon, begin lemevad nissin leinnun di besitra dikdushsha.

Umerucha da deitnesar, deikre nesira, minneh nafke kama sitrin acharanin, mitfarshan lezinnayyhu, vechullehu kayyeyman shelichan bealma, kol chad kadka chaze leh, ad deitmenun letata malchin vesarchin. velet lon kiyyuma tadir, keinnun acharanin dilella.

Behechala da itdavkuta distar misava, vechol tiuvetin misavin, umesaave lealma. hay ihu zammin leafaka bechol riga veshaata eshsha, velet man dekaim kameh. mehacha nafik eshsha derucha takkifa letatta, leitdena beyah chayyayve alma. umehacha nafka rucha melahata, deihu eshsha vetalga, deikre tzalmon. kema deat amer (Tehillim 68:15) tashleg betzalmon.

Behechala da, kayyeyman arbaa pitchin, demitparshan learba sitrin levar. veillen achadin vela achadin besitra dikdushsha. la itachad, ella deitchaze beinnun pitchin nehora denahir, veihu atar demittekan bechol pitcha ufitcha, leinnun chaside dishar ammin, innun dela avishu lon leyisrael, veishtaddalu immehon bikshot. illen kayyme beillen pitchin, venayyche tamman. (nusach acher mehay sitra vaneyychay mehay sitra).

Befitcha dehay hechala beemtzaita, levar, shit pitchin demitachade behay hechala, vechullehu achadin beh. hacha it kavvin petichan, lesitra dinhora kadisha, veinnun duchetin mittakni lemalche shear ammin, innun dela aku lon leyisrael, veaginu alayyhu tadir. illen it lon yekar beginehon deyisrael, veithanu behahu afela deinnun yatvin, miggo nehora denahir missitra dikdushsha. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 14:18) kol malche goyim kullam shachvu vechavod.

Vei avdu aku leyisrael, o dechiku lon. kama innun deachdin behu, vedayynin lehu letatta telat zimnin beyoma, mikkamma dinin meshanyayn illen meillen, leinnun malchin deaku lehu, deitdanu behahu alma bechamma dinin. vechol yoma veyoma sahadin sahaduta alayyhu deyisrael, veal mehemnuta dilhon, venachte letatta veitdanu tamman. zakkain innun yisrael bealma den, uvealma deate.
Ad hacha sheva hechalin, madore desitra misava, missitra denachash. zakkaa chulakeh man deishteziv minneh, umillechishuteh, dela yitneshich minnih, vela yatil beh arsa, deyyemut beh.
1034: Mikkol sitrin it leistammera minneh, meella umittatta. man deyishteziv meresha, la yishteziv mizzanva. kad achif resha, zakif zanva, mache vekatil.

Veim kol da, (Kohelet 10:11) im yishshoch hannachash belo lachash. kema detanenan, natil reshu veafik nishmeta. begin kach itzterich leh lebar nash leistammera, dela yechuv kame kudesha berich hu, begin dela yalchishu leh lehahu chivya deyinshoch veyiktol.

(Sefer acher zakkain inun tzaddikayyay deyadin archin kaddishin lemehach behu dela lemehach batar hahu chivyyay bisha sitra achara misava vametaperashey minneh velo atepatev avatreh zakkain inun bealma din zakkain inun bealma deate) (Bereshit 2:7) vayyitzer Adonai elohim et haadam afar min haadama. afar ihu, vela chomer. afar ihu, veyetuv leafra. kema deat amer, (Bereshit 3:19) ki afar atta veel afar tashuv. (nusach acher levatar dechata itavid mezona lenachash uvegin kach vechulei) levatar dechata, uvegin kach ketiv beh benachash, veafar tochal kol yeme chayyecha. afar da hu adam, dichtiv ki afar atta vegomer. uvegin kach ketiv afar, vela ketiv adama, vela chomer, uchetiv (Yeshayahu 65:25) venachash afar lachmo.

Ad deyitar kudesha berich hu, vivaar lehahu rucha misava mealma, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 25:8) billa hammavet lanetzach vegomer, veyakim lehahu afar, veyitar leh lemechde bealma, dichtiv (Yeshayahu 26:19) hakitzu verannenu shochne afar vegomer.

Ketiv (Bereshit 3:1) vehannachash haya arum, veha okimna. aval sitra derachiv aleh, yahiv leh chela leshalletaa, ulemifte, uleastaa. veda hu raza didchura, deha dechura shallit al nukeba, veyahiv bah chela. shimsha vesihara meshammeshin kachada, vela mitparshin lealmin, choshech vaafela meshammeshin kachada. ihu choshech, veihi afela. kema deat amer (Shemot 10:22) vayhi choshech afela. choshech vaarafel. begin deit choshech, veit choshech.
Tenan, man dechama gamal bechelmeh, mita itgezarat aleh, veishteziv minnah. begin deihu sitra misava, vehay ihu (Bereshit 6:13) ketz kol basar.

Yoma chad hava yativ ribbi elazar kameh deribbi shimon, amar ribbi elazar, hay ketz kol basar ithane meinnun karbenin dahavo yisrael mekarvin al gabbe madbecha, o la. amar leh, kolla havo mistappeke kachada, leella uletatta.

Veta chaze, kahane velevae veyisrael, innun ikrun adam, bechibbura deinnun reutin kaddishin, desalleka miggavavyyhu. vehahu imra, o kivsa, o hahu behema, hay dekarvin, itzterich ad la itkeriv al madbecha, lefarsha ala kol chatain, vechol chovin, vechol hirhurin bishin deavad. ucheden hahi, itkere behema becholla, bego innun chatain uvishin vehirhurin.

Kegavvna dekarbena daazazel, dichtiv, (Vayikra 16:21) vehitvadda alav et kol avonot bene yisrael vegomer, hachi name hacha. vechad salleka al gabbe madbecha, matu lah al chad teren. uvegin kach, da salleka leatreh, veda salleka leatrih, (244 amud bet, 239 amud alef) da beraza deadam, veda beraza divhema, kema deat amer (Tehillim 36:7) adam uvehema toshia Adonai.

Chavitin vechol shear menachot, leitteara rucha dekudesha, biruta dechahana, veshirata delevae, utzelota deyisrael. uvehahu tenana, veshamna vekimcha desalik, mitravavn umistappeke kol shear mare dedinin, dela yachle leshalletaa behahu dina deittemsar lon, vecholla bezimna chada. ta chaze, kolla itavid beraza dimhemnuta, leistappeka da beda, uleistalleka leella man deitzterich, ad en sof. (226 amud alef)

Amar ribbi shimon, aremit yeday bitzlotin leella, dechad reuta illaa, leella leella, kayyeyma al hahu reuta dela ityeyday, vela itpas lealmin, resha desatim yattir leella, vehahu resha appik ma deappik, vela yedia. venahir ma denahir, kolla bistimu.

Reu demachashava illaa, lemirdaf avatreh, uleitnahara minneh, chad perisu itperas, umiggo hahu perisa birdifu dehahi machashava illaa, mate vela mate, ad hahu perisa nahir ma denahir. ucheden hahu machashava illaa, nahir binhiru satim dela yedia. vehay machashava la yada.
Keden batash hay nehiru demachashava dela ityeyda, binhiru (nusach acher difrasa) difrisha, dekayyeyma denahir mimma,
1035: Dela yedia, vela ityeyda, vela itgalleya. ucheden, (nusach acher hay) da nehiru demachashava dela ityeyda, batash binhiru difrisa, venaharin kachada.

Veitavidu tisha hechalin, vehechalin lav innun nehorin, velav innun ruchin, velav innun nishmatin, vela it man dekayyeyma behu. reuta dechol tesha nehorin, kayyme kullehu bemachashava, deihi chad minnayyhu bechushebana, kullehu lemirdaf avatrayyhu. beshaata dekayyme bemachashava, vela mitdabbekan vela ityeydiu. veillen la kayyme, lav biruta, velav bemachashava illaa, tafsin bah vela tafsin. beillen kayymin kol razin dimhemnuta, vechol innun nehorin, meraza demachashava illaa uletatta, kullehu ikrun en sof. ad hacha matun nehorin, vela matun, vela ityeydiu lav hacha reuta, vela machashava.
Kad nahir machashava, vela ityeda mimman denahir, keden itlebash veastim go bina, venahir man denahir, veail da beda, ad deitkelilu kullehu kachada.

Uveraza dekarbena kad salik, kolla itkashshar da beda, venahir da beda, keden kayyme kullehu bisliku, umachashava itattar been sof. hahu nehiru denahir minneh machashava illaa, (nusach acher dela yada ihi bah kelal), ikre en sof, deminneh (nusach acher uminneh) ishtechach vekayyeyma venahir leman denahir, veal da kolla kaim. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay bealma den, uvealma deate.

Ta chaze, hay sitra achara, deikre ketz kol basar, kema dekishshura ishtechach leella bechidu, uf hachi name letatta, bechedvavta, ureuta leistappeka kolla leella vetatta, veima kayyeyma alayyhu deyisrael, kedka yeot.

Ta chaze, bechol resh yarcha veyarcha, kad sihara itchaddeshsha, yahavin leh lehay ketz kol basar, chulaka chada yattir al karbenin, leitasseka beh, veishtammash bechulakeh, vihe sitra deyisrael bilchodayyhu, begin deyitachadun bemalchehon.

Veda ihu sair, begin deihu chulaka deesav, dichtiv beh sair. (Bereshit 27:11) hen esav achi ish sair. veal da ihu ishtammash bechulakeh, veyisrael innun mishtammeshe bechulakehon. begin kach ketiv, (Tehillim 135:4) ki yaakov bachar lo yah yisrael lisgullato.

Veta chaze, hay ketz kol basar, kol reuteh lav ihu ella bevisra tadir. uvegin kach, tikkuna devisra tadir legabbeh, veal da ikre ketz kol basar. vechad ihu shallit, shallit al gufa, velav al nishmeta, nishmeta salleka leatrah, uvisra ityeyhiv leatar da, kegavvna dekarbena, diruta salleka laatar chad, uvisra leatar chad.

Ubbar nash deihu zakkaa, ihu karbena mammash lechappara, veachara delav ihu zakkaa, la. begin deveh muma, dichtiv (Vayikra 22:20) ki lo leratzon yihye lachem. veal da tzaddika kappara ihu bealma, vekarbena mammash. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay bealma den, uvealma deate.

Vaychas heanan et ohel moed, deha kad chafa anana yat mashkena, sharat shechinta beara, veitabbar rucha misava, deihu ketz kol basar mealma, veistallak veal benukeba dithoma rabba, verucha kaddisha shara al alma, dichtiv vaychas heanan et ohel moed.

Uchetiv velo yachol moshe lavo el ohel moed ki shachan alav heanan, begin derucha kaddisha shara al alma, verucha misava istallak, bar deamshichu leh innun chayyayvayya kemillekaddemin al alma, dei innun la amshichu leh al alma, la ishtechach.

Ulezimna deate, zammin kudesha berich hu leabera leh mealma, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 25:8) billa hammavet lanetzach umacha Adonai elohim dima meal kol panim vecherpat ammo yasir meal kol haaretz ki Adonai dibber. uchetiv (Zecharya 13:2) veet ruach hattumea aavir min haaretz. barucha Adonai leolam amen veamen. yimloch Adonai leolam amen veamen.
1036: Ribbi elazar patach, (Yeshayahu 7:11) sheal lecha ot meim Adonai elohecha haamek sheala o hagebeah lemala. istakkalna bedarin kadmain vedarin batrain, ma ben darin kadmain ledarin batrain. darin kadmain havo yadin umistakkelin bechachmeta illaa, veyadin letzarfa atvavn deityehivu leh lemoshe besinay, vaafillu chayyayvin divhon beyisrael, havo yadin go atvavn chachmeta illaa. veyadin go atvavn illain, vego atvavn tattain, chachmeta leanhaga ovadin behay alma.

Begin dechol at veat deittemsar leh lemoshe, havo mitatterin vesallekin al reshayyhu dechevavn illain kaddishin. vechullehu chevavn havo mitattere behu, ufarchin go avira, denachta miggo avira illaa, dakik dela yedia.

Vsallekin venachtin atvavn ravrevin veatvavn dekikin. atvavn ravrevin nachtin miggo hechala illaa temira decholla, veatvavn dekikin havo nachtin miggo hechala ochora tattaa, villen villen itmesaru leh lemoshe besinay.

Vechibbura deatvavn deinnun mitchabberan bitmiru bechol at veat, kegon 1, at yechida, mitchabberan immah bitmiru teren ochoranin laf. vechen kullehu itmesaru leh lemoshe besinay, vechullehu temirin go chavrayyay, zakkain innun.

Sheal lecha ot, ot mammash. dechullehu havo natlin beraza deatvavn. vechen berachav ma ketiv, (Yehoshua 2:12-13) unetattem li ot emet, da at 6, deda ikre ot emet. vei tema shear atvavn lav innun emet. in, ella ot da ot emet ikre.

Haamek sheala, da ot Adonai batraa devishma kaddisha. o hagebeah lemala, da at yod resha devishma kaddisha. veda ihu raza dichtiv, sheal lecha ot meim Adonai elohecha, ot mishshema kaddisha, mashma dichtiv meim Adonai, deda ihu shema dekudesha berich hu, at chad deveh, umashkena kaim al da.
Ta chazi, kad salik anana al mashkena veshara aloy, kol innun retichin, vechol
1037: Innun mane mashkena dilel, kullehu havo go anana. ma ketiv, (Shemot 40:35) velo yachol moshe lavo el ohel moed ki shachan alav heanan. uchetiv, vyyavo moshe betoch heanan, (Shemot 24:18) vayhi moshe bahar arbaim yom vearbaim layla i moshe la hava yachil leaala lemashkena, amay hava yativ betura kol innun arbein yomin.

Ella (sefer acher eno vechulei begin lekabbela orayyta zimna achara deha teren luchin ittebaru bekadmita vehasheta hava betura kemillekaddemin. amar rabbi yose i hachi veha ketiv 0 vayyakam moshe et hammishkan vechulei. uchetiv velo yachol moshe lavo el ohel moed. uchetiv vayhi moshe behar arbaim yom vegomer. uchetiv Vayikra el moshe vegomer. mashma demoshe betura hava behahu zimna dikra leh. uchetiv meohel moed. veohel moed lo hava betura desinay deha benayyhu deyisrael hava. amar leh behahu zimna ishtelimu arbein yomin. 46 yomin hava moshe betura. vaanana achara illaa hava metakken mashkena vetakin patore mikkol inun ruchin kaddishin leittakna atar deha) tere anani havo, (sefer acher anan denahir vaanan dacheshaych) chad deal beh moshe. vechad deshari al mashkena. ta chazi, ma ketiv (Shemot 40:35) uchevod Adonai male et hammishkan, milla la ketiv, ella male, dehava shelim leella vetatta, im mashkena diltatta. tikkuna temira denachat letatta veittakkenat shechinta.

Arba sitrin demashiryayn itgenizu. tikkuna kadmaa dechad mishmara, meinnun 4 mashiryayn, kolla ad deittakkanu. resha listar yemina tzadkiel, rav memana, rav mashiryayn, deihu techot shuletana demichael, veimmeh havo mittakkenan kol innun mashiryayn techot yedeh.

Vchad memana ittekam al arba telat, arba letatta, begin dechol innun mashiryayn illain, kad nachtin letatta, meshanyayn shema dilhon, bishmahan ochoranin, kad innun illain la mishtannin lealmin. vehay memana illaa tzadkiel kaim alayyhu lego. at chad natzitz al reshayyhu, veihi 1 zeera, kad hay at natzitz, kullehu natlin lehahu atar denatzitz hay netzitzu.

Lego minnayyhu, raziel rav memana, rav mashiryayn, dekayyeyma lego techot shuletanuta demichael. veimmeh kol innun mashiryayn ditchot yedeh. vechad memana kaim alayyhu betara, deitkere rumiel. vesacharin leh 12 memanan, telat telat 4 zimnin. veraziel rav memana kayyeyma al kullehu, dela ishtani shemeh. at chad natzitz al reshayyhu dechol innun mashiryayn, veihi at Rabbi. kad hay natzitz, natlin kullehu lehahu sitra dehahu netzitzu, hay at kayyayma al onsha dimgalle razin vsimanich (Mishlei 13:18) resh vekalon.

Lego minnayyhu, yofiel rav memana, rav mashiryayn, techot shuletanuta demichael, veimmeh havo mittakkenan kol innun mashiryayn ditchot yedeh. vela itgalleyayn hacha bechushbana, begin dela ishtelimu hacha ad deatu levet olamim. detaman ishtelimu kullehu, (Shemot 41 amud alef) veasgu mashiryayn bishlimu. uma deamaran hacha, kol innun mashiryayn ditchot yedeh, deitmesaru behahu shaata leaala immeh vechad memana kayyeyma alayyhu, vechachamiel shemeh, veyv memanan sacharin leh lechol ivar telat telat, kema deamaran. veyofiel rav memana kayyeyma al kullehu, dela ishtanne shemeh.

Zokkaa chulakeh demoshe dechame kol da, aval tzerufa da la itchame leenoy demoshe, ella tzerufa kadmaa deihu vayyikra, da hava chame moshe, hada hu dichtiv vayyikra el moshe. vetzerufa da ochora la galyayn leh. begin dishvacha debar nash la modiin lekammeh. vsimanich, (Bamidbar 12:8) tzeu shelashtechem, uchetiv vayyikra aharon umiryam, uchetiv pe el pe adabber bo, uchetiv lo chen avdi moshe, begin dela modiin shevacheh debar nash lekammeh.

Sallekin atvavn, veithadderu bechol innun mashiryayn kegavvna da, betzerufa da okir. vekala nafak veachriz veamar, okir enosh mippaz vegomer. levatar itmeshachu atvavn, vahavu netzitzin al reshayyhu dechol innun retichin, veishtechachu ad deittekanu leduchetayyhu.

Resha listar semala chizkiel rav memana, rav mashiryayn lechol innun dekayyme letara demashkena, techot shuletanuta degavriel. veimmeh mittakkenan behahu tara, kol innun mashiryayn ditchot yedeh. vechad memana ittakam al tara levar, vegazriel shemeh. veimmeh 12 memanan desacharin leh telat telat lechol setar, led sitrin.

Lego lego, baatar deikre kodesh, natzitz at chad go temiru dekodesh, veihi at 40 setima. hay natzitz bintzitzu al kullehu atvavn, vekala hu nafik mibbenayyhu deillen atvavn. keden batash netzitzu dehay at, venatil teren atvavn ochoranin netzitzin detalyayn baavira, veinnun 4 Adonai veishtear el, veitchabberan beillen ochoranin distar yemina, uvatshu illen beillen, venatle kullehu, veithadderan kadmae kemillekaddemin venafke levar, ucheden ikrun vayyikra el moshe.

(Vayikra 1:1) vayyikra el moshe vaydabber Adonai elav meohel moed lemor. ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:1) bati leganni achoti challa ariti mori im besami achalti yari im divshi shatiti yeni im chalavi vegomer, hay kera lav resheh sefeh, velav sefeh resheh. ketiv achalti yari im divshi shatiti yeni im chalavi, levatar ichlu reim. man dimzammen leochora, kad mezona mittakkan kameh. batar deihu achal, heach yazmin leochora.

Ella zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu baa ledakkea lehon, veitree behon mikkol shear ammin ovde avoda zara, umiddeitree behon baa lesalleka lehon mikkol mekatrege alma. ta chazi, (sefer acher batar deitavad mashkena) beyoma deittekam mashkena letatta, behahu yoma ittekam mashkena ochora leella immeh, dichtiv, (Shemot 40:17) hukam hammishkan setam, vehahu yoma chedvavta dekudesha berich hu hava.

Kevan deittekam mashkena ma ketiv, (Shemot 40:35) velo yachol moshe lavo el ohel moed. kad chama kudesha berich hu kach amar, uma al yede demoshe ittekam, veihu levar, miyyad vayikra el moshe. amar leh: moshe, chinucha deveta bemay hava, bisudata, adam ki yakriv mikkem karban laAdonai. hada hu dichtiv bati leganni achoti challa vegomer. Davar acher bati leganni, da gan eden dilella. achoti challa, da keneset yisrael, divhahu yoma izdavvevgu ziuugin becholla, izdavvevgu ziuugin behahu gan eden, begin deitbarchu kullehu mishshakyu denachala, veitkashsharu kol chad bechavreh, hada hu dichtiv ariti mori im besami achalti yari (Shir HaShirim Adonai:1)

Raya mehemna patach veamar bati leganni achoti challa, ihi malchut, adonay. ariti mori, da chesed, darga deavraham, deittemar aleh elech li el har hammor. im besami, da netztzach, darga deaharon, dichtiv beh (Shemot 30:23) veatta kach lecha besamim rosh. veinnun deroa yemina, beyarcha yemina. veraza demilla, (Tehillim 16:11) neimot bimincha netztzach. veinnun teren birkan lokovleh, chad magen avraham, vtinyayna avoda, dehu retztze.

Achalti yari, da gevura pachad yitztzechak. im divshi hod, darga dedavd, vehayeynu deroa semala, im yarcha semala. shatiti yeni im chalavi, guf uverit, yaakov im shelomo. levatar ichlu reim shetu vshichru dodim, 12 shevatim, 14 birchan. tosefet birkat hamminin, man achil lah, hahu deittemar beh bati leganni achoti chala.

Veit defalig lon beraza ochora, ariti mori im besami, guf uverit, yari im divshi, shoka yemina im semala. yeni im chalavi, deroa semala bimina, deinnun yini gevura, chalavi chesed. (ad kan raya mehemana)

Ribbi yehuda amar, ichlu reim shetu vshichru dodim, illen kol mare divava vilala, deitbesamu kullehu veitberachu kachada. deha misseudata demalka mithanyayn kolla. veematay achle kullehu. beshaata demalka (sefer acher ateacheday) ate chade. veal da malka itchade, vechadde lematronita bekadmita, levatar kullehu achlan vechaddan.

Ribbi abba amar, ichlu reim shetu veshichru dodim, illen innun shit dekamran, veillen innun dichtiv behu, (Shir HaShirim 1:4) hviani hammelech chadarav vegomer. shetu veshichru, mehahu yayin deravvi lecholla. ribbi elazar amar, kol innun diltatta, dechevan deinnun shit itbarchan, kullehu diltatta mitbarchan.

Ribbi shimon amar, kolla shappir, aval raza demilla, ichlu reim leella, shetu veshichru dodim letatta. amar leh ribbi elazar, man innun leella, uman innun letatta. amar leh yaut shailta, da atar illaa deinnun beachaduta bechedvavta dela mitparshan lealmin, illen ikrun reim. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden, veeden vehahu nahar la mitparshan lealmin, veishtechachu lealmin biruta beachaduta bechedvavta. shetu veshichru dodim, illen innun letatta, deikrun dodim, lezimnin yedian veha okimna.

Ta chaze beinnun illae ketiv behu achila bela shetiyya. may tama. man deit leh garbe dechamra, achila baya. uvegin detaman sharya chamra demintera, ketiv behu achila. uveinnun tattae devayayn shakyu, ketiv behu shetiyya, deha kol netian shakyu bayayn minnachala deamika. veal da, beillen achila, uveillen shetiyya. illen reim veillen dodim.

Amar leh ribbi elazar, itchaze deha dodim chavivuta innun, amay innun tattae. amar leh, innun detaavin da leda, vela mishtakkechin tadir, ikru dodim. veinnun demishtakkeche tadir, vela mitkasseyayn vela mitparshan da min da, ikru reim. veal da, illen dodim, veillen reim, illen biruta beachaduta tadir, veillen betiuveta lezimnin. veda hu shelemuta decholla, begin detitbarcha keneset yisrael, ucheden chedvavta bechullehu almin.
